---
title: "SMSF: Self Managed Super Fund"
description: "Information on the income tax and member contributions made to self-managed super funds in Australia."
---

Information on the income tax and member contributions made to self-managed super funds in Australia.

*Provides official SMSF statistical reports, annual overviews and methodology.*

The ATO defines it as \"the amount transferred in 2024-25 that exceeded the amount that was 'vested' in the member at the time of transfer\". A zero against a member who did transfer an overseas balance is the normal case rather than a sign that nothing came in.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_mcs_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_mcs_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_mcs_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_mcs_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_mcs_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_mcs_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_mcs_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_mcs_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_mcs_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_mcs_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_mcs_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_mcs_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"ASSBL_PRSNL_CNTRBTNS_AMT","d":"Members' own contributions that become taxable in the fund because the member claimed a deduction for them.","full":"Members' own contributions that become taxable in the fund because the member claimed a deduction for them. The ATO makes the notice the trigger: \"Personal contributions are assessable only if the member has provided a valid notice stating their intent to claim a deduction for their contributions by the required date and the SMSF trustee has acknowledged receipt of the notice\". The label also carries any untaxed element of a rollover received, up to the untaxed plan cap.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section B: Income - item 11","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Assessable personal contributions","k":"Dollar amount at item 11 label R2, assessable personal contributions, of the SMSF annual return","def":"A dollar amount for the whole fund, not reduced by any loss or outgoing, and recognised on receipt even where the contribution was allocated to the member's account in the following year.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section B: Income - item 11","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","lim":"It is a paperwork-driven number, not a measure of personal saving: the same contribution is invisible here if the member never lodged a deduction notice, and a late notice moves it to a different year. Including untaxed rollover elements also means a value can appear with no personal contribution behind it at all.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"ASSBL_TFR_FRM_RSRV_AMT","d":"Money moved out of a fund reserve into a member's account that is treated as a contribution and taxed as one.","full":"Money moved out of a fund reserve into a member's account that is treated as a contribution and taxed as one. The reported figure is deliberately larger than the money moved: where the allocation stood in for an employer contribution the trustee must \"multiply the amount that was transferred from the reserve by 1.176 to include the 15% tax that the SMSF would have paid\". The amount counts towards the member's concessional contributions, which is why reserve allocations are watched closely.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Transfer from reserve: assessable amount","k":"Dollar amount at label K, transfer from reserve: assessable amount, member section of the SMSF annual return","def":"A dollar amount for one member for the year, grossed up where the allocation replaced an employer contribution, and reported separately from the non-assessable reserve transfer at the label beside it.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","lim":"It is not the money that reached the member's account, so it cannot be added to the other member transactions to reconcile the closing balance without unwinding the 1.176 factor. Contributions held under a reserving strategy and allocated in the following year are also excluded from this label and reported as ordinary contributions instead.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_mcs_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_mcs_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_mcs_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_mcs_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_mcs_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_mcs_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_mcs_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_mcs_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_mcs_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_mcs_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_mcs_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_mcs_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"ASTS_IN_HS_AMT","d":"What the fund had tied up with related parties at 30 June: loans to them, leases to them and investments in them.","full":"What the fund had tied up with related parties at 30 June: loans to them, leases to them and investments in them. The instruction is to \"Write at label A the total value of the in-house assets on 30 June 2025\", and the number matters because Part 8 of the Superannuation Industry (Supervision) Act 1993 caps in-house assets as a share of the fund's total assets. Read against the total assets label on the same row it gives the ratio a regulator would look at first.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section H: Assets and liabilities - items 15 and 16","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Amount of loan to, lease to or investment in, related parties (known as in-house assets) at the end of the income year","k":"Dollar amount at item 15e label A, in-house assets, of the SMSF annual return","def":"A dollar amount at a single date for the fund as a whole, covering loans to, leases to and investments in related parties that meet the in-house asset definition.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section H: Assets and liabilities - items 15 and 16","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","lim":"It is a point-in-time value, so a breach that arose during the year and was cured before 30 June leaves no trace, and the column cannot show how long an exposure was held. Related-party investments that are not in-house assets, such as business real property leased to a member's business, are excluded by instruction, so the column understates related-party dealing rather than measuring it.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"ASTS_OTHR_AMT","d":"The residual Australian asset line: anything the fund held in Australia at 30 June that none of the named asset labels covered.","full":"The residual Australian asset line: anything the fund held in Australia at 30 June that none of the named asset labels covered. The ATO defines it as assets that are \"located in Australia\" and \"weren't included at labels A to M\", and directs derivatives here while keeping instalment warrants out. It is the column to check when a fund's named holdings do not add to its total assets.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section H: Assets and liabilities - items 15 and 16","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Other assets","k":"Dollar amount at item 15b label O, other assets, of the SMSF annual return","def":"A dollar amount at 30 June for the fund as a whole, sitting inside the Australian asset block that adds with the overseas block to total Australian and overseas assets.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section H: Assets and liabilities - items 15 and 16","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","lim":"Its content shifts with the form: as labels for crypto assets and borrowing arrangements were added, holdings moved out of this residual, so a time series of the column tracks the return's design as much as the fund's portfolio. Nothing inside it is identified, so a large value cannot be attributed to any asset class.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"AUSN_DRCT_INVSTMNT_OS_SHRS_AMT","d":"Overseas shares the fund holds through a geared structure, valued at 30 June.","full":"Overseas shares the fund holds through a geared structure, valued at 30 June. The ATO defines the label as the fund's beneficial interest in shares \"traded on overseas stock exchanges\" that are also \"held in a trust as security for a borrowing under a limited recourse borrowing arrangement\". Shares the fund owns outright overseas are reported at the overseas direct investment label instead, which is the column OS_SHRS_AMT holds.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section H: Assets and liabilities - items 15 and 16","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Limited recourse borring arrangements - Overseas shares","k":"Dollar amount at item 15b label J5, limited recourse borrowing arrangements - overseas shares, of the SMSF annual return","def":"A dollar market value of the assets held on trust, not of the money borrowed: the outstanding borrowing under these arrangements is reported separately in the liabilities item.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section H: Assets and liabilities - items 15 and 16","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","lim":"The abbreviated column name reads like an overseas direct investment, but the label it carries is the borrowing arrangement one, so treating it as the fund's overseas shareholding double counts against OS_SHRS_AMT and misstates gearing. Borrowing arrangement labels were also added to the return well after the earliest years in this file, so early years are empty by design rather than because no fund was geared.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"AUSN_FRNKG_CRDTS_FRM_NZC_AMT","d":"Australian franking credits attached to dividends from a New Zealand company that has joined the Australian imputation system.","full":"Australian franking credits attached to dividends from a New Zealand company that has joined the Australian imputation system. The ATO notes that \"Dividends paid by New Zealand resident companies don't normally carry Australian franking credits\" and that such a company \"can choose to join the Australian imputation system and distribute Australian franking credits with its dividends\". The dividend itself is reported as gross foreign income, so this column is only the credit.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section B: Income - item 11","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Australian franking credits from a New Zealand company","k":"Dollar amount at item 11 label E, Australian franking credits from a New Zealand company, of the SMSF annual return","def":"A dollar amount of imputation credits, not reduced by any loss or outgoing, and reduced by any supplementary dividend the fund received in connection with the franked dividend.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section B: Income - item 11","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","lim":"It is not a measure of New Zealand investment income and it is not New Zealand imputation credits, which cannot be claimed in Australia at all. Very few funds report anything here, so a zero says nothing about whether the fund held New Zealand shares.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"AUSN_NON_RSDNTL_RL_PRPTY_AMT","d":"Commercial or industrial property in Australia that the fund holds through a geared structure, valued at 30 June.","full":"Commercial or industrial property in Australia that the fund holds through a geared structure, valued at 30 June. The ATO defines the label as the fund's beneficial interest in \"non-residential real property\" that is \"held in a trust as security for a borrowing under a limited recourse borrowing arrangement\". The classic case is business real property bought with borrowed money and leased back to the members' own business, which is permitted where residential property leased to a member is not.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section H: Assets and liabilities - items 15 and 16","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Limited recourse borring arrangements - Australian non-residential real property","k":"Dollar amount at item 15b label J2, limited recourse borrowing arrangements - Australian non-residential real property, of the SMSF annual return","def":"A dollar market value of the property held on trust at 30 June, reported instead of, not as well as, the ungeared non-residential property label elsewhere in the same item.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section H: Assets and liabilities - items 15 and 16","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","lim":"The value is the asset, not the debt, so it cannot show gearing on its own; the outstanding borrowing sits at the liabilities label and the two have to be read together. The column is also silent on the tenant, so a property leased to a related business looks identical to one leased at arm's length.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"AUSN_OS_ASTS_TOTL_AMT","d":"The fund's whole balance sheet in one number: every asset it held at 30 June, in Australia and overseas.","full":"The fund's whole balance sheet in one number: every asset it held at 30 June, in Australia and overseas. It is the denominator for the in-house asset test and the usual measure of fund size. The return requires it to balance: \"The SMSF's total assets must equal its total liabilities, that is, the amount at label U Total Australian and overseas assets must equal the amount at label Z Total liabilities\".","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section H: Assets and liabilities - items 15 and 16","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"TOTAL AUSTRALIAN AND OVERSEAS ASSETS","k":"Dollar amount at item 15d label U, total Australian and overseas assets, of the SMSF annual return","def":"A dollar amount at 30 June, the sum of the Australian asset labels, the crypto asset label and the overseas direct investment labels on the same row.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section H: Assets and liabilities - items 15 and 16","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","lim":"It is not the fund's net wealth. Members' entitlements are counted as liabilities on this form, so total assets equalling total liabilities is a bookkeeping identity rather than a sign the fund is fully geared. As a subtotal of the asset labels beside it, adding it to them double counts.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"AUSN_RSDNTL_RL_PRPTY_AMT","d":"Australian housing the fund bought with borrowed money, valued at 30 June, which is the single most watched holding in the sector.","full":"Australian housing the fund bought with borrowed money, valued at 30 June, which is the single most watched holding in the sector. The ATO's example makes the reporting explicit: a residential property worth $300,000 held under an arrangement with $100,000 still owing is reported as \"$300,000 at label J1 Australian residential real property\" and \"$100,000 at label V1 Borrowings for limited recourse borrowing arrangements\". Residential property the fund owns outright is reported at a different label in the same item.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section H: Assets and liabilities - items 15 and 16","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Limited recourse borring arrangements - Australian residential real property","k":"Dollar amount at item 15b label J1, limited recourse borrowing arrangements - Australian residential real property, of the SMSF annual return","def":"A dollar market value of the fund's beneficial interest in the property held on trust as security, at 30 June, gross of the borrowing against it.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section H: Assets and liabilities - items 15 and 16","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","lim":"Taking the column as the fund's residential exposure understates it, because ungeared housing sits elsewhere in the item, and taking it as debt overstates it, because the borrowing is a separate label. A count of properties is also not implied: the arrangement's property count label is what says how many titles are behind the value.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"AUSN_SF_IND","d":"Whether the trustees say the fund met the residency test that keeps it taxed at the concessional rate.","full":"Whether the trustees say the fund met the residency test that keeps it taxed at the concessional rate. The consequence is severe: \"If the SMSF doesn't meet the definition of Australian super fund at all times during the income year, the SMSF isn't a complying SMSF and it won't receive the concessional rate of tax\". The question is most often at issue where trustees move overseas, which is why the fund's residency and its members' whereabouts are connected.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section A: SMSF information - items 1 to 10","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-a-smsf-information-items-1-to-10","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Australian superannuation fund","k":"Yes or no indicator at item 8 label A of the SMSF annual return","def":"A single indicator with two states, reported once for the fund for the income year in the status block at item 8, alongside the fund benefit structure code and the government contribution question.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section A: SMSF information - items 1 to 10","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-a-smsf-information-items-1-to-10","lim":"It is the trustees' own answer to a legal test, not an ATO determination, so a yes is a claim rather than a finding of residency. The test is also whole-of-year, so the indicator cannot show a period during the year when the fund would have failed it.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"AUSN_SHRS_AMT","d":"Australian shares the fund holds through a geared structure, typically instalment warrants, valued at 30 June.","full":"Australian shares the fund holds through a geared structure, typically instalment warrants, valued at 30 June. The ATO defines it as the fund's beneficial interest in \"public shares, unlisted shares, equities and similar financial contracts that are held in a trust as security for a borrowing under a limited recourse borrowing arrangement\". Shares the fund owns outright are reported at the listed and unlisted share labels instead, so this column is the geared slice of the equity portfolio.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section H: Assets and liabilities - items 15 and 16","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Limited recourse borring arrangements - Australian shares","k":"Dollar amount at item 15b label J4, limited recourse borrowing arrangements - Australian shares, of the SMSF annual return","def":"A dollar market value of the shares held on trust at 30 June, gross of the borrowing, which is reported separately in the liabilities item.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section H: Assets and liabilities - items 15 and 16","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","lim":"It is not the fund's Australian share holding despite the column name, and adding it to the listed and unlisted share columns is the right move only if you want total exposure rather than direct holdings. Derivatives are excluded by instruction and reported at other assets, so a geared derivative position is not visible here.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"BN","d":"A business identifier held against the member record, with no definition published beyond the words 'Business Number'.","full":"A business identifier held against the member record, with no definition published beyond the words 'Business Number'. The column sits on the member contributions statement table, and the one business identifier the ATO asks for in that part of the return is the employer's: \"Write at label A1 the ABN of the employer who made contributions to the member's account\". The fund's own ABN is asked for elsewhere, in Section A, so the employer reading is the more likely of the two but is not established.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Business Number","k":"Business identifier carried on the SMSF member contributions record","def":"An identifier value with no published format in the data item list. An ABN would be an 11-digit number, but PLIDA does not release business identifiers in clear, so the shape in the delivered data has to be checked before use.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","lim":"The custodian publishes only the words 'Business Number' and no definition, so whether the value is a contributing employer's ABN, the fund's own ABN or an internal reference is not established here. It should not be joined to BLADE or to any ABN-keyed file on the assumption that it is a clear-text ABN, and SF_SID on the same row is the fund key the data actually supports joining on.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_mcs_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_mcs_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_mcs_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_mcs_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_mcs_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_mcs_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_mcs_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_mcs_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_mcs_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_mcs_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_mcs_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_mcs_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"CG_NET_AMT","d":"The capital gain that actually reaches the fund's assessable income, after losses and the discount have been applied.","full":"The capital gain that actually reaches the fund's assessable income, after losses and the discount have been applied. The ATO defines it as the total capital gain for the year less \"any 2024-25 capital losses\", \"any prior year net capital losses\" and \"any other relevant CGT discount or concession\". Where the fund had gains above $10,000 a full capital gains tax schedule is attached, so the CGT dataset holds the working behind this single number.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section B: Income - item 11","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Net capital gain","k":"Dollar amount at item 11 label A, net capital gain, of the SMSF annual return","def":"A dollar amount net of current and prior year capital losses and of the one-third discount available to complying funds on assets held at least twelve months, and inclusive of the capital gains component of trust and partnership distributions.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section B: Income - item 11","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","lim":"It cannot be turned back into disposal proceeds or a gross gain, since losses and the discount are already inside it. It is also not the fund's whole capital gain: gains on segregated current pension assets are disregarded entirely and non-arm's-length capital gains are reported at the non-arm's-length income labels instead.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"CGT_EVNT_IND","d":"Whether anything happened during the year that engaged the capital gains rules, which is a wider question than whether the fund sold something.","full":"Whether anything happened during the year that engaged the capital gains rules, which is a wider question than whether the fund sold something. The ATO says answer yes if the fund \"had a CGT event occur during the income year\", \"received a share of net income from a trust that includes a capital gain\", or had a harvest or interest sale under a forestry managed investment scheme. It is the gate for the net capital gain amount and for attaching a capital gains tax schedule.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section B: Income - item 11","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Did you have a capital gains tax (CGT) event during the year?","k":"Yes or no indicator at item 11 label G of the SMSF annual return","def":"A single indicator with two states for the fund for the income year, reported ahead of the exemption or rollover question and the net capital gain amount on the same row.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section B: Income - item 11","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","lim":"A yes does not imply a gain or any tax: a loss, a rollover, a disregarded gain on a segregated pension asset, or a trust distribution carrying a gain all produce the same answer. A no is also not a statement that the fund's assets were unchanged, only that no CGT event was identified.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"CGT_SB_FFTN_YR_EXMPTN_AMT","d":"Sale proceeds a member put into the fund after selling a business asset held fifteen years or more, kept outside their non-concessional cap.","full":"Sale proceeds a member put into the fund after selling a business asset held fifteen years or more, kept outside their non-concessional cap. The ATO defines the label as \"the total value of personal contributions made by the member in 2024-25 that the member elected to exclude from their non-concessional contributions with a CGT small business 15-year exemption amount\". A value here marks a business exit rather than ordinary saving, so it identifies the retiring small business owner in the member file.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"CGT small business 15 year exemption amount","k":"Dollar amount at label D, CGT small business 15-year exemption amount, member section of the SMSF annual return","def":"A dollar amount for one member for the year, counted against the lifetime CGT cap, which was $1,650,000 in 2024-25 and is indexed annually.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","lim":"It is a contribution, not a capital gain, so it cannot measure what the business sold for and it does not identify the asset or the business. Contributions above the cap fall back to the ordinary personal contributions label, so a member at their limit shows a smaller number here than the sale would suggest.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_mcs_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_mcs_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_mcs_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_mcs_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_mcs_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_mcs_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_mcs_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_mcs_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_mcs_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_mcs_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_mcs_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_mcs_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"CGT_SB_RTMT_EXMPTN_AMT","d":"Business sale proceeds a member contributed under the retirement exemption, outside their non-concessional cap but inside a lifetime limit of its own.","full":"Business sale proceeds a member contributed under the retirement exemption, outside their non-concessional cap but inside a lifetime limit of its own. The ATO caps it hard: \"a member can't elect to apply a CGT small business retirement exemption to more than $500,000 during their lifetime\". Unlike the fifteen-year exemption beside it, this concession does not require a long holding period, so it reaches business owners exiting earlier.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"CGT small business retirement exemption","k":"Dollar amount at label C, CGT small business retirement exemption, member section of the SMSF annual return","def":"A dollar amount for one member for the year, subject both to the $500,000 lifetime retirement exemption limit and to the indexed CGT cap that it shares with the 15-year exemption label.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","lim":"One year's figure cannot show how much of the $500,000 lifetime limit is left, because the limit runs across a member's whole life and across funds. Amounts in excess of either limit are reported as ordinary personal contributions instead, so the column undercounts the money that came from a business sale.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_mcs_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_mcs_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_mcs_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_mcs_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_mcs_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_mcs_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_mcs_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_mcs_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_mcs_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_mcs_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_mcs_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_mcs_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"CHNGD_TAX_STS_OF_FND_AI_AMT","d":"A one-off amount brought to tax because the fund changed status, either losing complying status or becoming an Australian fund.","full":"A one-off amount brought to tax because the fund changed status, either losing complying status or becoming an Australian fund. The ATO writes at this label the amount included \"because it changed from either: complying to non-complying at the beginning of 2024-25; a foreign fund to an Australian super fund at the beginning of 2024-25\". For a fund that became non-complying the amount is close to its entire asset value, worked out as asset value less non-concessional contributions, and it is taxed at 45 per cent.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section B: Income - item 11","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Assessable income due to changed tax status of fund","k":"Dollar amount at item 11 label T, assessable income due to changed tax status of fund, of the SMSF annual return","def":"A dollar amount for the fund for the year, not reduced by any loss or outgoing, and not exempt under the exempt current pension income rules.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section B: Income - item 11","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","lim":"It is a penalty inclusion, not income the fund earned, so leaving it in an income series makes the fund look enormously profitable in the year it failed. The single column also mixes two opposite events, a compliance failure and an inbound residency change, which cannot be told apart without the status indicators elsewhere on the return.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"CL_CF_NET_AMT","d":"The stock of capital losses the fund still has available to set against future capital gains.","full":"The stock of capital losses the fund still has available to set against future capital gains. The ATO defines it as \"the total of any unapplied net capital losses from collectables and unapplied net capital losses from all other CGT assets and events\", and capital losses can be carried forward indefinitely until a gain absorbs them. Where this and the fund's tax losses together exceed $100,000, a separate losses schedule is attached to the return.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section E: Losses - item 14","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-e-losses-item-14","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Net capital losses carried forward to later income years","k":"Dollar amount at item 14 label V, net capital losses carried forward to later income years, of the SMSF annual return","def":"A dollar amount at the end of the income year, accumulated across years rather than earned in one, and reported separately from tax losses at the label beside it.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section E: Losses - item 14","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-e-losses-item-14","lim":"It is a closing balance, not the year's loss, so a change between years mixes new losses with losses used up against gains and cannot be read as this year's investment result. It also merges collectables losses with all other losses even though collectables losses can only ever be applied against collectables gains, so the usable amount is smaller than the total for a fund holding art or wine.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"CNTR_OTHR_INCL_SPR_CO_CNTR_AMT","d":"Contributions received for this member that fit no other contribution label, mostly the government super co-contribution and low income super amount.","full":"Contributions received for this member that fit no other contribution label, mostly the government super co-contribution and low income super amount. The ATO tells trustees to include at label M \"super co-contributions and low income super amounts paid to the SMSF for the benefit of the member by us\", along with any foreign fund transfer the member chose to have taxed inside the fund. It is the last of the thirteen contribution labels that add to label N Total contributions on the same member row, so it works as a residual rather than as a named category.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G member and supplementary member information, label M","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Any other contributions (including Super Co-contributions)","k":"Dollar amount reported at member label M, any other contributions","def":"A dollar amount for one member for one income year, gross and not reduced by contributions tax or expenses. It sits between the named contribution labels A to L and the label N total on the same row.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G member and supplementary member information, label M","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","lim":"It cannot separate a government co-contribution from a low income super amount or from an elected foreign transfer, so it is not a clean measure of government contributions. The ATO narrows it: report the contributions only where \"a member's account was opened on or after 1 July 2007\" or that member's assessable contributions for the year came to more than $1,000. Label R3 is mandatory and the ATO tells trustees to write a zero at it where the question does not apply, so the column is populated on almost every return whether or not the fund had such contributions.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section B income item 11, label R3","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"No-TFN quoted contributions","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section B item 11 label R3, no-TFN-quoted contributions","def":"A dollar amount of contributions rather than of tax; the extra tax charged on it, 32 per cent for a complying fund, is reported separately at Section D label J. Those labels run from employer and personal contributions through the CGT small business exemptions, a personal injury election, spouse and child contributions, downsizer proceeds, foreign fund amounts and reserve transfers to the residual label M. Money that arrived by other routes is outside it: rollovers in, allocated earnings and benefit payments each have their own label further down the member row.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G member and supplementary member information, label N","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Total contributions","k":"Dollar amount reported at member label N, total contributions","def":"A dollar total for one member for one income year, gross of the contributions tax the fund pays, equal to the sum of the thirteen contribution labels on the same row.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G member and supplementary member information, label N","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","lim":"It mixes concessional and non-concessional contributions, so it cannot be compared with either contributions cap. The ATO asks for \"the total tax withheld from payments to the SMSF because the SMSF had not quoted its ABN or TFN\", and the payer must give the fund a payment summary showing the amount. This is about the fund's own registration details, not a member's: contributions for a member who has not quoted a tax file number are reported at Section B label R3 instead.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D income tax calculation statement item 13, label H3","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Credit for tax withheld - where ABN or TFN not quoted (non-individual)","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section D item 13 label H3, credit for tax withheld where ABN or TFN not quoted","def":"A dollar amount of tax already withheld, reported to the fund by a third party on a payment summary, and one of the five credits that add to label H Eligible credits.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D income tax calculation statement item 13, label H3","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","lim":"It cannot tell you how large the underlying payment was, only the tax taken out of it, and the gross payment is reported somewhere in Section B with no link back to this credit. The 2018-19 instructions ask for \"the calculated interest amount of 50 cents or more for early payments\" and tell trustees not to write the early payment itself at this label. The label has since gone from the return: the 2025 eligible credit questions run H2, H3, H5, H6 and H8 with no H1, so a series built on this column ends part way through the PLIDA years.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2019 instructions, Section D item 13, H1 to H eligible credit questions","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2019-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-annual-return/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13/h1-h2-h3-h5-h6-h8-and-h-eligible-credit-questions","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Credit for interest on early payments - amount of interest","k":"Dollar amount of interest reported at Section D item 13 label H1, credit for interest on early payments","def":"A dollar amount of interest calculated under the early payment rules, not a payment or a tax, and reported only where the calculated interest reaches 50 cents.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2019 instructions, Section D item 13, H1 to H eligible credit questions","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2019-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-annual-return/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13/h1-h2-h3-h5-h6-h8-and-h-eligible-credit-questions","lim":"It does not measure how much the fund prepaid or how early. It also excludes liabilities that were satisfied by crediting PAYG instalments, withholding credits or a running balance surplus, which the ATO says do not attract early payment interest at all.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"CR_FRW_AMT","d":"Tax withheld in Australia under the foreign resident withholding rules from payments made to the fund, claimed back as a credit.","full":"Tax withheld in Australia under the foreign resident withholding rules from payments made to the fund, claimed back as a credit. The ATO allows the credit only where the amount was both \"withheld in Australia\" and \"remitted to us\", and it includes the fund's share of such credits passed through a partnership or a trust. Withholding on a property sale is excluded and goes to label H8 instead.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D income tax calculation statement item 13, label H2","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Credit for tax withheld - foreign resident withholding","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section D item 13 label H2, credit for tax withheld under foreign resident withholding","def":"A dollar amount of Australian withholding tax, reported to the fund by the payer on a payment summary, and one of the components of label H Eligible credits.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D income tax calculation statement item 13, label H2","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","lim":"The label name misleads: this is withholding under the foreign resident rules on Australian-source payments, not tax the fund paid overseas. Foreign tax paid abroad is relieved through the foreign income tax offset at label C1 and never appears here.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"CR_INTST_ON_NO_TFN_TO_AMT","d":"Interest the ATO pays a fund on the no-TFN tax offset it is claiming this year, credited in the tax calculation.","full":"Interest the ATO pays a fund on the no-TFN tax offset it is claiming this year, credited in the tax calculation. Entitlement is tied to the offset: \"If the SMSF hasn't claimed a no-TFN tax offset at label E2, it can't claim a credit at label H6\", and only calculated interest of 50 cents or more is written. The trigger is an employer failure, so a value says nothing about the member or the fund.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"CR_NO_TFN_TO_AMT","d":"A refundable offset that gives back the extra no-TFN contributions tax the fund paid in an earlier year, once the member finally supplies a tax file number.","full":"A refundable offset that gives back the extra no-TFN contributions tax the fund paid in an earlier year, once the member finally supplies a tax file number. The claim is narrow: the fund must have paid the additional tax \"in any of the 3 previous income years\" for a member who quoted their tax file number for the first time in the current year. The ATO adds that because SMSF members are usually the trustees, \"it is rare for an SMSF to pay no-TFN contributions tax, and therefore rare for SMSFs to be entitled to a no-TFN tax offset\".","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D income tax calculation statement item 13, label E2","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"No-TFN tax offset","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section D item 13 label E2, no-TFN tax offset","def":"A dollar amount of refundable tax offset, equal to the additional no-TFN contributions tax being recovered, and reported in the same refundable group as franking credits.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D income tax calculation statement item 13, label E2","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","lim":"The year on the row is the year of recovery, not the year of the contributions, which can be up to three years earlier. It also cannot be used to count members without tax file numbers, because only members who supplied one during the year generate an entry.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"CR_RFNDBL_FRNKG_CRDTS_AMT","d":"The franking credits a complying fund claims as a refundable offset, which is why many SMSFs finish the year receiving a refund rather than paying tax.","full":"The franking credits a complying fund claims as a refundable offset, which is why many SMSFs finish the year receiving a refund rather than paying tax. The ATO includes credits attached to dividends \"including where they are exempt current pension income\", and credits attached to franked distributions from New Zealand franking companies. Only a complying fund uses this label; a non-complying fund puts the same credits at label C2, where the unused part is lost rather than refunded.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D income tax calculation statement item 13, label E1","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Complying fund's franking credits tax offset","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section D item 13 label E1, complying fund's franking credits tax offset","def":"A dollar amount of imputation credit treated as a refundable tax offset under section 67-25 of the ITAA 1997, drawn from the franking credits already declared as income in Section B, including those at labels L and E.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D income tax calculation statement item 13, label E1","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","lim":"It is an offset claim, not dividend income, so it cannot stand in for the fund's shareholdings or their yield. Neither is it the refund: the refund is what remains after gross tax and the other offsets have been worked through.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"CR_RFNDBL_NRAS_TO_AMT","d":"A refundable offset for a fund holding an approved National Rental Affordability Scheme dwelling, set entirely by the certificate it was issued.","full":"A refundable offset for a fund holding an approved National Rental Affordability Scheme dwelling, set entirely by the certificate it was issued. The certificate claimed on the 2024-25 return must cover the scheme year 1 May 2024 to 30 April 2025.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D income tax calculation statement item 13, label E3","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"National rental affordability scheme tax offset","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section D item 13 label E3, National Rental Affordability Scheme tax offset","def":"A dollar amount of refundable offset taken from a government certificate rather than calculated by the fund, reported in the refundable group with franking credits and the exploration credit offset.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D income tax calculation statement item 13, label E3","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","lim":"The scheme year runs to 30 April, so the offset on a return does not match the income year the rest of the row describes. The column also does not identify the dwelling, which appears only as part of the fund's residential real property total in Section H.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"CRNT_PNSN_EXMT_INCM_AMT","d":"The fund's income that is exempt from tax because it supports retirement phase pensions, declared up front in Section A.","full":"The fund's income that is exempt from tax because it supports retirement phase pensions, declared up front in Section A. The ATO requires the two exempt pension income entries on the return to agree: the amount at item 10 label A \"must be the same as the amount that you write at label Y Exempt current pension income for item 11 in Section B\". Only funds that answered yes to paying retirement phase income stream benefits during the year complete it at all.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section A SMSF information items 1 to 10, item 10 label A","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-a-smsf-information-items-1-to-10","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Exempt current pension income amount","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section A item 10 label A, exempt current pension income amount","def":"A dollar amount of exempt income worked out under the segregated assets method, the proportionate method or both, and not reduced by the expenses of earning it.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section A SMSF information items 1 to 10, item 10 label A","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-a-smsf-information-items-1-to-10","lim":"It is fund income treated as exempt, not the pensions paid to members, which appear on the member rows as income stream payments. Reading it as a share of the fund's income needs gross income at Section B label W as the denominator, since the column carries no percentage.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"CRNT_PNSN_INC_EXMT_CAL_MTHD_CD","d":"Which method the fund used to work out its exempt pension income: segregated assets, proportionate, or both within the one year.","full":"Which method the fund used to work out its exempt pension income: segregated assets, proportionate, or both within the one year. The return puts this as two tick boxes rather than a single choice, and the ATO tells trustees to \"Print X in the appropriate box or boxes (labels B or C or both labels B and C)\". A fund using the proportionate method also answers a further question at label D on whether it obtained an actuarial certificate.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section A SMSF information items 1 to 10, item 10 labels B and C","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-a-smsf-information-items-1-to-10","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Which method did you use to calculate your exempt current pension income?","k":"Exempt current pension income method indicator, Section A item 10 labels B and C","def":"A code standing for a pair of tick boxes, so the domain has to allow segregated only, proportionate only and both, and is blank for a fund that paid no retirement phase pensions.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section A SMSF information items 1 to 10, item 10 labels B and C","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-a-smsf-information-items-1-to-10","lim":"The method says nothing about how much income was exempt, and it does not identify which assets were segregated. A both-methods value is not a contradiction or an error: it is normal for a fund that starts or stops a pension part way through the year.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"CRNT_PNSN_INCM_EXMT_AMT","d":"The exempt pension income figure as it appears inside the income statement, where it is subtracted from gross income to reach assessable income.","full":"The exempt pension income figure as it appears inside the income statement, where it is subtracted from gross income to reach assessable income. The instructions make the arithmetic explicit: total assessable income at label V is gross income at label W less this amount. The ATO also warns against netting costs off it, since \"Expenses incurred in gaining or producing exempt income aren't generally deductible\" and belong in the non-deductible column of Section C.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section B income item 11, label Y","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Exempt current pension income","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section B item 11 label Y, exempt current pension income","def":"A dollar amount of exempt income, equal by instruction to the Section A item 10 figure on the same return, and entering the income statement as a subtraction rather than an addition.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section B income item 11, label Y","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","lim":"It duplicates the Section A column, so adding the two double counts the fund's exempt income.
