The label was added for 2018-19, when the ATO said crypto-currency \"needs to be reported separately in the crypto-currency label within Section H Assets and liabilities\". By the 2025 return the wording had shifted to crypto asset, and the cash and term deposits label explicitly pushes crypto here rather than allowing it to sit with cash.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2019 instructions, What's new in 2018-19","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2019-instructions/whats-new-in-201819","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Other investments - Crypto-Currency","k":"Dollar value at 30 June reported at Section H item 15c label N, crypto asset investment","def":"A dollar value at a single date, 30 June, self-assessed by the trustee, covering crypto held as an investment of the fund.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2019 instructions, What's new in 2018-19","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2019-instructions/whats-new-in-201819","lim":"The column is empty for every year before 2018-19, so a jump in the series is the label appearing rather than funds buying in. It is a closing value, not a purchase, a disposal or a gain, and crypto held on trust under a limited recourse borrowing arrangement is reported among the LRBA labels instead.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"CSH_TRM_DPSTS_AMT","d":"The fund's cash and term deposits at 30 June, valued in Australian dollars and held with Australian institutions.","full":"The fund's cash and term deposits at 30 June, valued in Australian dollars and held with Australian institutions. The ATO reads the label widely, giving \"money market funds and cash management trusts\" as examples, so it is broader than a bank balance. It excludes crypto assets, which go to the separate crypto label, and any deposit held on trust under a limited recourse borrowing arrangement.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section H assets and liabilities items 15 and 16, label E","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Cash and term deposits","k":"Dollar value at 30 June reported at Section H item 15b label E, cash and term deposits","def":"A dollar value at one date, 30 June, self-assessed by the trustee as part of the asset side of the fund's balance sheet, and one of the labels adding to total Australian and overseas assets.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section H assets and liabilities items 15 and 16, label E","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","lim":"A closing balance says nothing about the cash that moved through the fund during the year, so it cannot support a liquidity or turnover measure. Cash held outside Australia is reported among the overseas asset labels, so this is not the fund's total cash.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"DDCTD_TAX_LSS_AMT","d":"Losses from earlier years that the fund is using this year, capped so that they cannot create a fresh loss.","full":"Losses from earlier years that the fund is using this year, capped so that they cannot create a fresh loss. The ATO allows the claim \"only to the extent that its total assessable income exceeds total deductions (other than tax losses)\", and requires the losses to be applied against net exempt income first where the fund pays pensions. Capital losses are not part of it: they run through the net capital gain label and the Section E carry forward.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section C deductions and non-deductible expenses item 12, label M1","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Tax losses deducted","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section C item 12 label M1, tax losses deducted","def":"A dollar deduction, self-assessed, drawn from a stock of carried forward losses that the fund reports separately at Section E label U.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section C deductions and non-deductible expenses item 12, label M1","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","lim":"It measures losses used, not losses held, so a fund with a large accumulated stock shows zero in a year with little income. Losses tied to non-arm's length income are excluded and can only reduce that income, so the column understates the fund's total loss position.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"DDCTNS_OTHR_DDCTN_TYP_CD","d":"A single letter naming the largest item inside the fund's other deductible expenses, taken from the ATO's table of other amounts categories.","full":"A single letter naming the largest item inside the fund's other deductible expenses, taken from the ATO's table of other amounts categories. The published codes are A for balancing adjustment amounts, B for a contribution that is a fringe benefit, C for exclusion of personal contributions, E for environmental protection activities, F for forex losses, I for a listed investment company capital gain deduction, N for a deduction relating to foreign non-assessable non-exempt income, R for a return of contributions by a non-complying fund, T for taxation of financial arrangements amounts and O for anything else. The rule is to \"print the code from Table 7 that best describes the largest amount\" written at the label.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section C deductions and non-deductible expenses item 12, table 7","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Other deductions code","k":"Single-letter other amounts category code beside Section C item 12 label L1","def":"One letter from the closed Table 7 list, mandatory whenever an amount appears at label L1 and blank otherwise.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section C deductions and non-deductible expenses item 12, table 7","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","lim":"It describes only the biggest component, so a row coded F can hold forex losses that are a minority of the amount and several other items besides. That sweep takes in interest, capital works, decline in value, member insurance premiums, the auditor fee, investment and administration expenses, forestry payments, other amounts and prior year tax losses. Taxable income on the next line is total assessable income less this figure.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section C deductions and non-deductible expenses item 12, label N","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"TOTAL DEDUCTIONS","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section C item 12 label N, total deductions","def":"A dollar total covering the deductible column only. Costs attributable to exempt pension income are not deductible and sit outside it, so a fund fully in retirement phase can run real expenses and still report a small total here.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"DEBT_SCRT_AMT","d":"The value at 30 June of bonds, notes and similar Australian debt instruments the fund holds directly.","full":"The value at 30 June of bonds, notes and similar Australian debt instruments the fund holds directly. Only securities traded or available in Australia belong here; overseas debt is reported among other overseas assets.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section H assets and liabilities items 15 and 16, label F","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Debt securities","k":"Dollar value at 30 June reported at Section H item 15b label F, debt securities","def":"A dollar value at 30 June, self-assessed, covering Australian debt and hybrid securities the fund holds in its own right.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section H assets and liabilities items 15 and 16, label F","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","lim":"It does not separate a plain bond from a hybrid carrying equity risk, so it is a weak proxy for the fund's credit exposure. The ATO says the amount \"shouldn't be reduced by any loss or outgoing incurred in gaining or producing the income\", so it is a gross figure. Dividends that reached the fund inside a trust or partnership distribution are excluded and reported at the trust and partnership labels, which makes this a measure of direct shareholdings only.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section B income item 11, label J","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Unfranked dividend amount","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section B item 11 label J, unfranked dividend amount","def":"A dollar amount of assessable dividend income, gross, covering unfranked dividends and unfranked non-share dividends received directly.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section B income item 11, label J","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","lim":"It is not the fund's dividend income: franked dividends, New Zealand company dividends and dividends inside trust or partnership distributions all sit at other labels, and non-arm's length private company dividends are carved out again. The ATO puts at label E1 the deductible amount, \"for example, the decline in value of a depreciating asset that the SMSF uses for the purposes of gaining or producing assessable income\", and sends the part attributable to exempt pension income to the paired non-deductible label. Second-hand depreciating assets in existing residential property have been largely excluded since 1 July 2017.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section C deductions and non-deductible expenses item 12, label E1","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Deduction for decline in value of depreciating assets","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section C item 12 label E1, deductible decline in value of depreciating assets","def":"A dollar deduction for one income year under the capital allowance rules, self-assessed, rather than the cost or the written down value of the asset.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section C deductions and non-deductible expenses item 12, label E1","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","lim":"It cannot be read as the fund's capital spending, and it names no asset. The total covers assets held \"including instalment warrants\", which is the wording the abbreviated column name preserves from an earlier edition of this label.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section H assets and liabilities items 15 and 16, labels J1 to J6 and J","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Limited recourse borrowing arrangements","k":"Dollar value at 30 June reported at Section H item 15b label J, limited recourse borrowing arrangement assets","def":"A dollar value at 30 June, being the sum of the arrangement sub-labels for Australian residential and non-residential property, overseas property, Australian and overseas shares, and other assets.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section H assets and liabilities items 15 and 16, labels J1 to J6 and J","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","lim":"It is the geared asset, so it overstates the fund's own stake by the size of the loan sitting in the liabilities item. The ATO says a death benefit increase \"is also known as an 'anti detriment payment'\", and confines it to a member who died before 1 July 2017 with the benefit paid by 30 June 2019: \"This deduction is not available for later financial years.\" The deduction is the tax saving amount divided by the low tax component rate of 15 per cent, so it is far larger than the top-up itself.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2019 instructions, Section C item 12, G1 Death benefit increase","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2019-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-annual-return/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12/g1-death-benefit-increase","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Death benefit increase","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section C item 12 label G1, death benefit increase","def":"A dollar deduction, self-assessed and grossed up from the tax saving amount actually added to the benefit, claimed in the year the lump sum was paid.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2019 instructions, Section C item 12, G1 Death benefit increase","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2019-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-annual-return/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12/g1-death-benefit-increase","lim":"The column closes after 2018-19, so a zero in later tables is the law ending rather than funds declining to claim. Where the total beats the tax and the levy, \"the SMSF may be entitled to a refund of the excess\".","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D income tax calculation statement item 13, label H","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Eligible credits","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section D item 13 label H, eligible credits","def":"A dollar subtotal, being the sum of the credit sub-labels on the same return, all of them amounts already withheld from the fund or owed to it by the ATO.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D income tax calculation statement item 13, label H","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","lim":"Adding it to its own components double counts. The ATO includes contributions made \"under a salary sacrifice arrangement or to meet the employer's obligations under the super guarantee, awards, agreements or other obligations\", together with super guarantee charge shortfall amounts and transfers out of the ATO's super holding accounts special account. Contributions the member made themselves belong at the personal contributions label even where they have claimed a deduction for them.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G member and supplementary member information, label A","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Employer contributions","k":"Dollar amount reported at member label A, employer contributions","def":"A dollar amount for one member for one income year, gross of the contributions tax the fund pays, recorded when the fund received the money rather than when it allocated it.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G member and supplementary member information, label A","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","lim":"It cannot be read as the member's wage or their super guarantee entitlement, because salary sacrifice and voluntary employer amounts are mixed into the same figure. For a defined benefit interest the number is a notional taxed contribution, a formula output rather than cash received.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_mcs_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_mcs_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_mcs_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_mcs_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_mcs_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_mcs_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_mcs_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_mcs_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_mcs_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_mcs_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_mcs_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_mcs_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"ERNGS_LSS_ALCTD_AMT","d":"Earnings allocated to this member's account for the year, less the expenses, taxes and losses charged against it.","full":"Earnings allocated to this member's account for the year, less the expenses, taxes and losses charged against it. The ATO writes the label as a catch-all: it holds \"any transactions affecting the member's closing balance that you haven't included at another question in Section F or Section G\", including investment earnings, allocated costs, insurance proceeds for death or disability cover, and reserve allocations not reported at the two transfer-from-reserve labels. A negative amount is flagged with a loss box rather than a minus sign.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G member and supplementary member information, label O","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Allocated earnings or losses","k":"Signed dollar amount reported at member label O, allocated earnings or losses","def":"A signed dollar amount for one member for one income year, net of the tax and expenses allocated to that account.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G member and supplementary member information, label O","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","lim":"It is not an investment return, and it cannot be turned into one without an account balance to divide by, since the tax and expense drag inside it cannot be separated. Anything the trustee could not place elsewhere lands here, so it is not a clean earnings series.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_mcs_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_mcs_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_mcs_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_mcs_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_mcs_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_mcs_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_mcs_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_mcs_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_mcs_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_mcs_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_mcs_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_mcs_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"ESI_TO_AMT","d":"An offset for the fund investing in an early stage innovation company during the year, subject to a group-wide ceiling.","full":"An offset for the fund investing in an early stage innovation company during the year, subject to a group-wide ceiling. The ATO caps it: \"The maximum offset (including current year and carried forward prior year amounts) that the fund, and its affiliates combined, can claim in 2024-25 is $200,000.\" Where the sophisticated investor test is failed for even one investment, the fund cannot claim at all if it paid more than $50,000 for eligible shares, and entitlement can also arrive through a partnership or trust that invested.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D income tax calculation statement item 13, label D3","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Early stage investor tax offset","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section D item 13 label D3, early stage investor tax offset","def":"A dollar offset, non-refundable but able to be carried forward, worked out from what the fund paid for eligible shares in the year rather than from the value of the holding.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D income tax calculation statement item 13, label D3","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","lim":"It measures a tax entitlement, not the size of the investment, and it is reduced by claims made by the fund's affiliates, so it understates a related group's early stage exposure. It also eats into the ceiling for the current year: step 5 of the label D3 calculation is to \"Subtract from $200,000 the amount (if any) reported at label D4 Early stage investor tax offset carried forward from previous year\". Whether an amount can be carried forward at all is decided by Division 65 of the Income Tax Assessment Act 1997.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D income tax calculation statement item 13, label D4","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Early stage investor tax offset carried forward from previous year","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section D item 13 label D4, early stage investor tax offset carried forward","def":"A dollar offset brought forward, non-refundable, reported alongside the current year claim within the non-refundable carry forward group.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D income tax calculation statement item 13, label D4","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","lim":"It does not date the investment that generated it, which may be several years old, and it is not simply the unused remainder of an earlier claim once the carry forward adjustments are applied. Ordinary foreign resident withholding is a different credit and goes to label H2.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D income tax calculation statement item 13, label H8","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Credit for foreign resident capital gains withholding amounts","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section D item 13 label H8, credit for foreign resident capital gains withholding","def":"A dollar amount of withholding tax remitted by a third party, including the fund's share of such credits arriving through a trust distribution, and part of the eligible credits total.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D income tax calculation statement item 13, label H8","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","lim":"It is not evidence that the fund is a foreign resident, since the regime withholds from a vendor who has not established otherwise. It also gives neither the sale price nor the gain: the withholding is a slice of the purchase price and the capital gain is reported in the income section.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"FRGN_INCM_GRS_AMT","d":"All the assessable income the fund earned from foreign sources, before any expense or foreign tax is taken off.","full":"All the assessable income the fund earned from foreign sources, before any expense or foreign tax is taken off. Debt deductions are not netted off unless they belong to an overseas permanent establishment, and a negative result is marked with a loss box.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section B income item 11, label D","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Net foreign income","k":"Signed dollar amount reported at Section B item 11 label D, net foreign income","def":"A signed dollar amount, self-assessed, and mandatory whenever a value appears at the gross foreign income label on the same return.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section B income item 11, label D","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","lim":"It is not gross foreign income less foreign tax: the tax stays inside the gross figure and is relieved separately through the foreign income tax offset. Franked dividends received through a trust or partnership, from a New Zealand franking company, or as non-arm's length income are all reported at other labels.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section B income item 11, label K","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Franked dividend amount","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section B item 11 label K, franked dividend amount","def":"A dollar amount of assessable dividend income, gross, covering direct holdings only and excluding the imputation credits carried with the dividend.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section B income item 11, label K","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","lim":"Adding it to the franking credit label gives a grossed up dividend, which is neither cash received nor taxable income on its own, so the two columns should not be summed casually. Where the fund pays pensions the payment is apportioned before it is written here.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section C deductions and non-deductible expenses item 12, label U1","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Forestry managed investment scheme deduction","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section C item 12 label U1, deductible forestry managed investment scheme expenses","def":"A dollar deduction, self-assessed, for payments made under the scheme in the income year rather than the value of the forestry interest the fund holds.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section C deductions and non-deductible expenses item 12, label U1","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","lim":"It records money paid out, not the scheme's performance, and it names no scheme. The ATO instruction is \"Write at label X the SMSF's income from all FMISs\", and adds that \"The amount at label X shouldn't be reduced by any loss or outgoing incurred in gaining or producing the income.\" Capital gains on a forestry interest are excluded here and go to label A instead, so a fund that sold its interest can show nothing at X in the year it made the most money from the scheme.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section B: Income - item 11, label X","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Forestry managed investment scheme income","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section B label X, SMSF annual return","def":"A whole-dollar amount, gross of expenses, covering the fund's share of income from every forestry scheme it held. The forestry scheme rules in Division 394 also began part way through the period this asset covers, so a zero in an early year can mean the label was not yet in use rather than that the fund held nothing.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"GOVT_SPR_COCNTRBTN_IND","d":"Whether the fund's trust deed lets it accept government super co-contributions and low income super amounts for its members.","full":"Whether the fund's trust deed lets it accept government super co-contributions and low income super amounts for its members. The ATO asks \"Does the fund trust deed allow the SMSF to accept the government's super co-contribution and low income super amount for all eligible members?\" and the trustee marks yes or no. It is a statement about the deed, not a record that any co-contribution was received; the money itself, when it arrives, is reported for each member at Section F label M.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section A: SMSF information - items 1 to 10, item 8 label C","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-a-smsf-information-items-1-to-10","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Does the fund trust deed allow acceptance of the Government's Super Co-contribution and Low Income Super Amounts?","k":"Yes or no indicator, Section A item 8 label C, SMSF annual return","def":"A two-state indicator taken from a tick box. The question widened over time: the low income super amount was added to a box that had asked only about the government super co-contribution, so the wording is not identical across years.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section A: SMSF information - items 1 to 10, item 8 label C","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-a-smsf-information-items-1-to-10","lim":"A yes does not mean the fund received anything, and a no does not mean a member was ineligible - it means the deed as written would not let the fund take the payment. The ATO says \"Write at label I the total of all gross distributions from partnerships received in 2024-25\" and \"If the total amount is a loss, print L in the LOSS box.\" Interest, rent and franking credits that came through a partnership belong here rather than at their own labels, while capital gains, foreign income and non-arm's length amounts are stripped out to labels A, D1 and U3.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section B: Income - item 11, label I","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Gross distribution from partnerships","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section B label I, SMSF annual return","def":"A whole-dollar amount that can be negative, with the sign carried by a separate loss flag rather than by the number. Nor can it be compared straight against label C or label B, since amounts that would sit there are diverted here whenever they arrive through a partnership.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"GRS_INCM_AMT","d":"The fund's total income for the year before any pension exemption is taken out.","full":"The fund's total income for the year before any pension exemption is taken out. The ATO builds it by adding the income labels: \"Add the amounts from Section B, item 11 - labels A to U, including D and R\", and warns against double counting the component labels D1, R1, R2, R3, R6, U1, U2 and U3 that make up those totals. The ATO says \"Write at label C the total interest income that the SMSF earned in 2024-25\" and that the amount \"shouldn't be reduced by any loss or outgoing incurred in gaining or producing the income.\" Bank and term deposit interest belongs here, as does interest the ATO itself pays the fund, but interest received through a partnership or trust is reported at labels I or M instead.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section B: Income - item 11, label C","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Gross interest","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section B label C, SMSF annual return","def":"A whole-dollar amount, gross, restricted to Australian-source interest. The ATO requires the pre-withholding figure: \"The amount that you write at label H must be the gross value, that is, it must include both the amounts paid to the SMSF and the amounts that payers withheld.\" The withheld tax is claimed back on the same return in Section D at label H3, so a non-zero value here should have a credit beside it.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section B: Income - item 11, label H","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Gross payments where ABN not quoted","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section B label H, SMSF annual return","def":"A whole-dollar gross amount, supported by a PAYG payment summary from each payer and by an attached non-individual PAYG payment summary schedule.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section B: Income - item 11, label H","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","lim":"It is not a measure of income type - the payments could be anything - and it is not the tax withheld, which is a different column. On the current calculation statement the ATO says \"Write at label B the total of label T1 and label J\", so it is tax on taxable income plus the extra tax on contributions made for members whose tax file number the fund does not hold. The rate mix inside it is not one number: a complying fund pays 15 per cent on ordinary income and 45 per cent on non-arm's length income, and a non-complying fund pays 45 per cent throughout.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section D: Income tax calculation statement - item 13, label B","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Gross tax","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section D label B, SMSF annual return calculation statement","def":"A whole-dollar amount, the top line of the calculation statement. The ATO explains that \"An interest charge is imposed on certain distributions from non-resident trusts under Section 102AAM of the Income Tax Assessment Act 1936\", and the trustee works out the charge and writes it in. It sits outside the tax calculation itself, added after tax payable when the amount due for the year is struck.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section D: Income tax calculation statement - item 13, label G","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Section 102AAM interest charge","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section D label G, SMSF annual return calculation statement","def":"A whole-dollar amount, self-calculated by the trustee rather than raised by an assessment, and reported only when a charge arises.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section D: Income tax calculation statement - item 13, label G","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","lim":"It is an interest charge, not tax, so adding it to tax payable overstates the fund's income tax. A non-zero value marks a foreign trust distribution but does not size it. The ATO says \"Write at label S any assessable income of the SMSF that doesn't fall into any other category in Section B\", and the code letters cover balancing adjustments, listed investment company capital gain amounts, forex gains, income from premiums paid for death or disability benefits, financial arrangement gains and payments subject to foreign resident withholding. Because the categories are unrelated, the dollar figure only means something once the code beside it is read.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section B: Income - item 11, label S and Table 5","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Other income","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section B label S, SMSF annual return","def":"A whole-dollar gross amount paired with a one-letter code from a published list, with code O reserved for anything the other letters do not describe.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section B: Income - item 11, label S and Table 5","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","lim":"The label mixes categories that have nothing in common, so a time series of it measures no single economic quantity. The ATO asks \"Did the fund pay retirement phase superannuation income stream benefits to one or more members during 2024-25?\" and a yes opens the exempt current pension income amount at the same item. A yes therefore marks a fund in or partly in the pension phase, which changes how much of its investment income is taxed.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section A: SMSF information - items 1 to 10, item 10","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-a-smsf-information-items-1-to-10","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Did the fund pay an income stream to one or more members in the income year?","k":"Yes or no indicator, Section A item 10, SMSF annual return","def":"A two-state indicator from a tick box, answered for the fund and not for a member. It gates the exempt current pension income amount reported beside it and repeated at Section B label Y.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section A: SMSF information - items 1 to 10, item 10","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-a-smsf-information-items-1-to-10","lim":"It does not say how many members were paid, how much, or whether the pension ran for the whole year, and the member-level income stream payment amounts are held on separate rows. The question was also narrowed to retirement phase income streams, so a yes in an early year and a yes now are not exactly the same statement.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"INCM_STRM_PMT_AMT","d":"The pension the fund paid this member during the year.","full":"The pension the fund paid this member during the year. The ATO says \"Write at label R2 the total amount of super income stream benefits paid to the member in 2024-25\", and a code beside it names the benefit type. Money the member took as a lump sum, including a full or partial commutation of a pension, is not counted here - it goes to label R1 - so a member drawing down heavily can show a small figure at this label.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information, label R2","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Income stream payment","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section F or G label R2, SMSF annual return member statement","def":"A whole-dollar amount on the member's own statement, paired with a benefit type code. It is the only field that dates a row: the income and deduction labels are annual totals for this year, while the asset and liability labels are balances at its 30 June, and the member statements combine both. A fund must lodge for a year if it was an SMSF at 30 June or was wound up during the year, so a fund can appear for part of a year and then stop.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, How to get the SMSF annual return 2025","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/how-to-get-the-smsf-annual-return-2025","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Income year","k":"Financial year (1 July to 30 June) the return relates to","def":"A year identifier rather than a date, present on both the annual return table and the member statement table so that the two can be joined for the same fund and year.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, How to get the SMSF annual return 2025","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/how-to-get-the-smsf-annual-return-2025","lim":"It is not a lodgement or processing date, so it says nothing about when the ATO received or amended the return, and an amended return replaces the earlier figures for the same year rather than adding a row. A yes has consequences elsewhere on the same return: the ATO says the wind-up date \"must be a date from 1 July 2024 to 30 June 2025 and be the date on which the fund no longer held any assets\", the total member closing account balances label is left blank, and total liabilities are reported as zero. It is the field that closes a fund's history rather than one that describes its finances.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section A: SMSF information - items 1 to 10, item 9","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-a-smsf-information-items-1-to-10","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Was the fund wound up during the year","k":"Yes or no indicator, Section A item 9, SMSF annual return","def":"A two-state indicator from a tick box, accompanied on the form by the wind-up date and by a separate question on whether all lodgement and payment obligations were met.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section A: SMSF information - items 1 to 10, item 9","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-a-smsf-information-items-1-to-10","lim":"It does not mark the year the fund stopped operating in any economic sense - a fund can pay out every member and still lodge as a live fund until the wind-up is completed. The ATO says \"Write at label C the value (on 30 June 2025) of life insurance policies owned by the SMSF that were issued by an organisation registered under the Life Insurance Act 1995.\" This is an asset the fund owns, not the cover it buys for members: premiums for death and disability cover are an expense in Section C, and the two have no arithmetic relationship.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section H: Assets and liabilities - items 15 and 16, label C","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Insurance policy","k":"Dollar asset value reported at Section H label C, SMSF annual return","def":"A whole-dollar balance sheet value at 30 June, taken from the fund's own statement of financial position. The value is also the trustee's own, since SMSF assets are self-valued at market value rather than independently priced.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"INSRNC_PRM_NN_DDCTBL_EXPNS_AMT","d":"The part of the fund's member insurance premiums that it cannot deduct.","full":"The part of the fund's member insurance premiums that it cannot deduct. Non-deductible premiums, in the ATO's words, include \"any insurance premiums paid by a non-complying SMSF\" and \"payments for insurance that covers events other than death, the existence of a terminal medical condition, or temporary or permanent disability\". The deductible part of the same premiums sits at label F1 on the same row, so the two together are what the fund spent on cover.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section C: Deductions and non-deductible expenses - item 12, label F2","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Non-deductible expenses - Death or disability premiums","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section C label F2, SMSF annual return non-deductible expenses","def":"A whole-dollar expense amount in the non-deductible column of Section C, feeding total non-deductible expenses rather than total deductions.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section C: Deductions and non-deductible expenses - item 12, label F2","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","lim":"It is not the fund's insurance bill and not a measure of cover, because it is only the disallowed slice, and its size is driven as much by the deduction rules as by the premium. The label wording also changed: the custodian calls it death or disability premiums while the current return calls it insurance premiums, and the separate non-deductible column was added part way through the period this asset covers, so an early year can be empty rather than zero.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"INTST_EXPNS_OS_TOTL_AMT","d":"Deductible interest on money the fund borrowed from an Australian source, which is what the custodian's own description says this column holds.","full":"Deductible interest on money the fund borrowed from an Australian source, which is what the custodian's own description says this column holds. The ATO says \"Write at label A1 the amount of deductible interest expenses incurred on borrowings from sources within Australia\", deductible to the extent the borrowing was used to buy income-producing assets, finance operations or meet current expenses. The non-deductible part of the same interest is at label A2, and interest on overseas borrowings is a separate pair of labels.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section C: Deductions and non-deductible expenses - item 12, label A1","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Interest expenses within Australia","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section C label A1, SMSF annual return deductions","def":"A whole-dollar deduction, limited to interest and reported by the source of the borrowing rather than by what the money bought. Transfers from a foreign fund are excluded and reported at the contribution labels instead.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information, label P","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Inward amounts less any rolled in contributions","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section F or G label P, SMSF annual return member statement","def":"A whole-dollar member-level amount, supported by a rollover benefits statement from the transferring fund. It is subtracted, not added, when total assessable contributions are struck at label R.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section B: Income - item 11, label R6","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Transfer of liability to life insurance company or PST","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section B label R6, SMSF annual return","def":"A whole-dollar amount reported inside the assessable contributions block, reducing the total at label R by the amount transferred under section 295-260 of the ITAA 1997.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section B: Income - item 11, label R6","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","lim":"Despite sitting among income labels, a larger figure lowers the fund's assessable income rather than raising it, so summing the contribution labels without subtracting it overstates income. The transfer also does not carry the tax on no-TFN contributions, which stays with the fund, so it is not a clean shift of the whole liability.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"LBLTS_TOTL_AMT","d":"The whole right-hand side of the fund's balance sheet at 30 June, which is dominated by what it owes its own members.","full":"The whole right-hand side of the fund's balance sheet at 30 June, which is dominated by what it owes its own members. Borrowings, total member closing account balances, reserve accounts and other liabilities are added to get it, and the ATO requires that \"Label Z Total liabilities must equal label U Total Australian and overseas assets\". Because member balances are counted as a liability, this total is normally about the same size as the fund's assets rather than a measure of debt.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section H: Assets and liabilities - items 15 and 16, label Z","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"TOTAL LIABILITIES","k":"Dollar total reported at Section H label Z, SMSF annual return","def":"A whole-dollar total at 30 June, made up of labels V to Y, and written as zero if the sum would be negative or if the fund was wound up during the year.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section H: Assets and liabilities - items 15 and 16, label Z","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","lim":"Reading it as fund borrowing is wrong by an order of magnitude, since the borrowings component is usually a small part of it and most funds have none. The component split into limited recourse, temporary and other borrowings was added later than the total, so a series of the components starts well after the series of label V.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"LBLTY_INFO_OTHR_LBLTS_AMT","d":"Everything the fund owed at 30 June that is not a borrowing, a member balance or a reserve.","full":"Everything the fund owed at 30 June that is not a borrowing, a member balance or a reserve. The ATO defines it by exclusion, as \"the total value (on 30 June 2025) of liabilities that you couldn't include in labels\" V Borrowings, W Total member closing account balances and X Reserve accounts. In practice it collects accrued tax, unpaid fees and benefits owed but not yet paid, so it is a small residual rather than a category.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section H: Assets and liabilities - items 15 and 16, label Y","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Other liabilities","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section H label Y, SMSF annual return liabilities","def":"A whole-dollar residual balance at 30 June, defined only by what the three named liability labels do not take.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section H: Assets and liabilities - items 15 and 16, label Y","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","lim":"It cannot be interpreted as a kind of liability, because its content depends on what the trustee could not fit elsewhere and no code identifies it. A fund that treats an amount as a reserve and one that treats the same amount as other liabilities both balance, so the split between labels X and Y is a bookkeeping choice.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"LISTD_SHRS_AMT","d":"The value of listed Australian shares the fund held directly at 30 June.","full":"The value of listed Australian shares the fund held directly at 30 June. The ATO says \"Write at label H the value (on 30 June 2025) of public shares and equities held by the SMSF that are traded on Australian stock exchanges\", and directs listed trust units to label A, debt securities to label F and shares held under a limited recourse borrowing arrangement to a separate label. Listed property trusts and most exchange traded funds sit here rather than with listed shares, which is why the two labels have to be read together.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section H: Assets and liabilities - items 15 and 16, label A","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Listed trusts","k":"Dollar asset value reported at Section H label A, SMSF annual return","def":"A whole-dollar market value at 30 June, covering trust units that can be bought through a stockbroker. The ATO is explicit about the direction: it asks \"Did the SMSF have any Australian loans (where the SMSF is the lender)?\" and takes the total value of loans where the fund is the lender and the loan was entered into or finalised in Australia. Money the fund has borrowed is a liability at label V, so the two must not be confused.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section H: Assets and liabilities - items 15 and 16, label G","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Loans","k":"Dollar asset value reported at Section H label G, SMSF annual return","def":"A whole-dollar carrying value at 30 June of amounts lent out, on the fund's own valuation. Overseas lending falls outside the label and is reported among overseas assets.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section H: Assets and liabilities - items 15 and 16, label G","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","lim":"It cannot be used to identify lending to related parties, which is captured separately by the in-house asset question, and it says nothing about whether the loan is performing. The ATO says \"Write at label R1 the total amount of super lump sum benefits paid for the member in 2024-25\", with a code beside it for the benefit type. Commutations count here rather than as pension payments: \"A payment made as a result of a full commutation of an income stream is a super lump sum and must be reported at label R1\", and since 1 July 2017 a partial commutation is treated the same way.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information, label R1","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Lump sum payment","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section F or G label R1, SMSF annual return member statement","def":"A whole-dollar member-level amount, paired with a benefit type code, and separate from rollovers out of the fund, which go to label Q.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information, label R1","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","lim":"It is not a withdrawal by the member in every case, because a death benefit paid to a dependant or a release authority payment to the ATO also lands here, and the code is needed to tell them apart. The 2017 change to commutations breaks comparability with earlier years, since payments that once appeared as income stream benefits now appear as lump sums.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_mcs_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_mcs_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_mcs_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_mcs_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_mcs_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_mcs_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_mcs_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_mcs_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_mcs_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_mcs_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_mcs_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_mcs_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"LSP_CD","d":"A letter saying why a lump sum was paid, which is the only field separating a retirement withdrawal from a death benefit or an early release.","full":"A letter saying why a lump sum was paid, which is the only field separating a retirement withdrawal from a death benefit or an early release. The ATO says \"Use Table 11 to work out which code applies to the amount you wrote at label R1\", with letters for a member aged 60 or over, a member under 60, a death benefit to a dependant, a death benefit to a non-dependant, a terminal medical condition, other types such as permanent incapacity or severe financial hardship, and a release authority payment. Where more than one type was paid, the letter follows the largest payment.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Sections F and G, Table 11 lump sum benefit type codes","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Lump sum payment - code","k":"Lump sum benefit type code letter, Section F or G label R1 code box","def":"One letter from a published list, attached to the lump sum amount and required whenever that amount is present.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Sections F and G, Table 11 lump sum benefit type codes","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","lim":"It codes a whole year of lump sums with one letter, so a member who took a retirement lump sum and a hardship payment shows only the larger. The letter also carries no dollar split, so it cannot be used to value death benefits separately from ordinary withdrawals on the same row.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_mcs_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_mcs_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_mcs_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_mcs_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_mcs_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_mcs_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_mcs_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_mcs_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_mcs_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_mcs_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_mcs_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_mcs_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"MBR_ACNT_BLNCS_AMT","d":"The total of every member's closing account balance at 30 June, reported as a liability of the fund.","full":"The total of every member's closing account balance at 30 June, reported as a liability of the fund. The ATO ties it to the member statements: \"The amount at label W must equal the total of all the label S Closing account balance amounts in Sections F and G.\" It is the closest thing the return has to the size of the fund from the members' point of view, and for a fund with no borrowings it is close to total assets.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section H: Assets and liabilities - items 15 and 16, label W","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Total member closing account balances","k":"Dollar total reported at Section H label W, SMSF annual return liabilities","def":"A whole-dollar total at 30 June, and the reconciling link between the fund-level balance sheet and the member-level statements on the other table.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section H: Assets and liabilities - items 15 and 16, label W","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","lim":"It is left blank rather than set to zero when the fund was wound up during the year, so a missing value in a fund's last year is a rule and not a gap. Because trustees value the fund's assets themselves, a large one-year movement can be a revaluation rather than contributions or earnings.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"MBR_RCRD_CD","d":"A code attached to a member's row on the fund's member statement, most likely identifying the record rather than any amount on it.","full":"A code attached to a member's row on the fund's member statement, most likely identifying the record rather than any amount on it. The only coded field the ATO attaches to a member record is the account status letter used in Section G, where O means \"The member's account was open on 30 June 2025, and the SMSF will accept payments from us\" and C means the account was closed. Section F holds members who were still in the fund at 30 June and Section G those who left, died, or could not be fitted into Section F for lack of space, so a record code may also carry that split.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Member record","k":"Code identifying the member record on the SMSF annual return member statement","def":"A short code on the member row.
