Reading a missing code as a live account would also be wrong, since the account status box is left empty for every member reported in Section F.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_mcs_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_mcs_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_mcs_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_mcs_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_mcs_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_mcs_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_mcs_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_mcs_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_mcs_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_mcs_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_mcs_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_mcs_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"MGT_ADMIN_EXPNS_AMT","d":"What it cost to run the fund as an entity, to the extent the cost is deductible.","full":"What it cost to run the fund as an entity, to the extent the cost is deductible. The ATO says \"Write at label J1 the amount of deductible management and administration expenses\" and counts tax agent fees, the SMSF supervisory levy, the general interest charge and the shortfall interest charge among them, while sending investment management expenses to labels I1 or I2 and auditor fees to labels H1 or H2. Setup costs, deed amendments and late lodgement penalties are not deductible and go to the non-deductible column instead.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section C: Deductions and non-deductible expenses - item 12, label J1","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Management and administration expenses","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section C label J1, SMSF annual return deductions","def":"A whole-dollar deduction of a revenue nature for administering the fund, sitting alongside a non-deductible counterpart at label J2.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section C: Deductions and non-deductible expenses - item 12, label J1","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","lim":"It is not the full cost of running the fund, because the audit fee, investment costs and anything non-deductible are recorded at other labels, so a cost-per-fund measure built on this column alone is too low. It also cannot be compared cleanly across time, since the deductible share depends on how much of the fund's income is exempt pension income.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"MNGD_INVSTMNTS_OTHR_AMT","d":"Money the fund has placed with Australian managed vehicles that is not a listed trust, unlisted trust or insurance policy.","full":"Money the fund has placed with Australian managed vehicles that is not a listed trust, unlisted trust or insurance policy. The ATO says the label \"includes investments with all external investment managers and pooled superannuation trusts (PSTs) located or registered in Australia\", and adds that \"A managed fund that is registered in Australia is an Australian managed investment even if it invests in overseas assets.\" That last rule matters: an Australian managed fund holding global shares is counted here, not among the fund's overseas assets.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section H: Assets and liabilities - items 15 and 16, label D","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Other managed investments","k":"Dollar asset value reported at Section H label D, SMSF annual return","def":"A whole-dollar market value at 30 June, the residual of the four Australian managed investment labels, classified by where the manager is registered rather than by what it holds.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section H: Assets and liabilities - items 15 and 16, label D","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","lim":"It cannot be used to measure the fund's home bias, because a globally invested Australian managed fund is indistinguishable from a domestic one at this label. The residual definition also means its content shifts when a trustee reclassifies a holding between it and the listed or unlisted trust labels.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"MONTH_DOB_DT","d":"The month a member was born, cut down from the full date of birth the fund reports for that member.","full":"The month a member was born, cut down from the full date of birth the fund reports for that member. The ATO asks the provider to \"Provide the member's day, month and year of birth, if known\" and allows partial dates: \"Write '0' in any part of the date of birth that is unknown\", giving an example of 00/02/1975 for a member known to be born in February 1975. The month is what survives into this asset, so age can be worked out to about a month against any event date on the same row.","dsrc":"ATO, Superannuation member contributions statement 2013 and later financial years, Section C: Member details, question 28","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/superannuation-member-contributions-statement-2013-and-later-financial-years/instructions/section-c-member-details","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Month of birth","k":"Month and year of birth, truncated from the reported date of birth","def":"A truncated date carrying month, and in practice the year, rather than a full calendar date. The underlying reported value is a self-reported member detail held by the fund, not a verified registry record.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Superannuation member contributions statement 2013 and later financial years, Section C: Member details, question 28","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/superannuation-member-contributions-statement-2013-and-later-financial-years/instructions/section-c-member-details","lim":"Because the source permits zero-filled parts of the date, a month can itself be unknown and recorded as zero, which is not the same as missing. Age derived from it is age of the member as recorded by this fund, so a person with accounts in several funds can carry inconsistent birth details across rows.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_mcs_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_mcs_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_mcs_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_mcs_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_mcs_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_mcs_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_mcs_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_mcs_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_mcs_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_mcs_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_mcs_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_mcs_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"MONTH_IDV_DTH_DT","d":"The month a member died, as reported by the fund on the member's own statement.","full":"The month a member died, as reported by the fund on the member's own statement. It is only ever completed in the supplementary member section: the ATO says that for members reported in Section G you \"write the date of death, if the member died during 2024-25\". A deceased member is reported there rather than in the ordinary member section, so this field and the section a row came from move together.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Month of death","k":"Month and year of death, truncated from the reported date of death","def":"A truncated date carrying month and year, present only on rows for members who died in the reporting year and reported by the trustee rather than by a registry.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","lim":"It records the year the fund reported a death, so a death late in a year that the trustee reports in the following return is dated to that later return rather than corrected in place. It is also not a death registration: for population work the death registry is the authority, and this field only tells you the fund knew.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_mcs_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_mcs_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_mcs_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_mcs_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_mcs_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_mcs_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_mcs_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_mcs_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_mcs_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_mcs_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_mcs_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_mcs_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"NET_TAX_AMT","d":"The tax the fund is left owing for the year once every offset has been applied.","full":"The tax the fund is left owing for the year once every offset has been applied. It is the last line of the calculation statement: where refundable tax offsets are \"less than the tax at label T3, the shortfall becomes the SMSF's tax payable amount at label T5 Tax payable\", and where they exceed it the fund writes zero and takes the excess as a refund. A complying fund with large franking credits can show zero here while still reporting substantial gross tax.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section D: Income tax calculation statement - item 13, label T5","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Net tax","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section D label T5, SMSF annual return calculation statement","def":"A whole-dollar amount bounded below by zero, struck after non-refundable and refundable offsets but before PAYG instalment credits, eligible credits and the supervisory levy.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section D: Income tax calculation statement - item 13, label T5","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","lim":"A zero does not mean no tax, because franking credits can wipe out the liability and even generate a refund, so this column understates the tax borne on the fund's income. The calculation statement has also been renumbered between versions of the return, so match this field on its printed name, Tax payable, rather than on where it sits in the statement.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"NEW_SBTOTL_AMT","d":"Tax still owing after the first tier of offsets, the ones that cannot be refunded or carried forward.","full":"Tax still owing after the first tier of offsets, the ones that cannot be refunded or carried forward. The ATO says \"Subtract the amount at label C Non-refundable non-carry forward tax offsets from label B Gross tax\", write the result if it is positive and zero otherwise, and warns that \"If the non-refundable non-carry forward tax offsets are greater than the gross tax, the excess can't be carried forward and is lost.\" It is a working line, not a liability: two further tiers of offsets are applied below it.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section D: Income tax calculation statement - item 13, label T2","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"SUBTOTAL 1","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section D label T2, SMSF annual return calculation statement","def":"A whole-dollar intermediate figure bounded below by zero, sitting between gross tax and tax payable in the calculation statement.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section D: Income tax calculation statement - item 13, label T2","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","lim":"Because it is floored at zero, the difference between gross tax and this line understates offsets whenever offsets exceed tax, and the lost excess is not recorded anywhere on the return. The subtotal lines in the calculation statement have also been renumbered between versions of the return, so check the label letter for the year in hand before joining a series across years.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"NN_ARMS_LN_PRVT_COY_DVD_NT_AMT","d":"Dividends from a private company that the trustee has judged not to be at arm's length, net of the expenses of earning them.","full":"Dividends from a private company that the trustee has judged not to be at arm's length, net of the expenses of earning them. The ATO builds the label from the dividends paid to the fund, plus any franking credits the fund can claim as an offset, less deductible expenses attributable to them, and directs that \"Include non-share dividends that are non-arm's length income at label U1.\" Anything reported here is taxed at 45 per cent even in a complying fund, so the label carries a large tax consequence for a small number of funds.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section B: Income - item 11, label U1","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Net non-arm's length private company dividends","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section B label U1, SMSF annual return","def":"A whole-dollar net amount, one of the three non-arm's length income labels that add to the total at label U. Expenses deducted against it are not shown again in Section C.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section B: Income - item 11, label U1","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","lim":"It rests on the trustee's own judgement about whether a dealing was at arm's length, so a zero can mean the income was arm's length or that the trustee did not treat it as caught. Because it is net of attributable expenses, it is not comparable with the gross dividend labels J, K and L on the same return.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"NN_ARMS_LN_TRST_DSTRBTN_NT_AMT","d":"Trust income the fund received that is not at arm's length, net of the expenses of earning it.","full":"Trust income the fund received that is not at arm's length, net of the expenses of earning it. The ATO takes \"any non-arm's length income which the complying SMSF received in 2024-25 as a share of net income from a trust\" and subtracts deductible expenses attributable to it. A distribution is caught automatically where the fund has no fixed entitlement to the trust's income, which is why an SMSF holding units in a discretionary trust reports here rather than at label M.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section B: Income - item 11, label U2","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Net non-arm's length trust distributions","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section B label U2, SMSF annual return","def":"A whole-dollar net amount that can include capital gains and franked dividends received through the trust, and that feeds the non-arm's length total at label U taxed at 45 per cent.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section B: Income - item 11, label U2","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","lim":"The amount is a residual of the trustee's classification, so movement between this label and label M can reflect a change of view rather than a change in the investment. A net figure also cannot be compared against label M, which is gross of the expenses of earning it.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"NN_CMPL_PRV_NN_CMP_FND_CNT_AMT","d":"Contributions made for this member while the fund was non-complying, reported once in the first year the fund becomes complying again.","full":"Contributions made for this member while the fund was non-complying, reported once in the first year the fund becomes complying again. The ATO asks it only of a fund whose status changed, and takes contributions that \"were made on or after 10 May 2006, and when the SMSF was non-complying\" and that \"haven't previously been reported at this question in an earlier year\". The point is to bring historic contributions into the member's non-concessional contribution history rather than to record money received this year.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information, label T","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Contributions from non-complying funds and previously non-complying funds","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section F or G label T, SMSF annual return member statement","def":"A whole-dollar member-level catch-up amount, counted in total contributions at label N but deliberately excluded from the member's opening account balance.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information, label T","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","lim":"It is not a flow for the reporting year, so treating it as contributions received in that year overstates the year and understates the earlier ones it belongs to. It is also rare and almost always zero, since it only arises when a fund moves from non-complying to complying.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_mcs_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_mcs_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_mcs_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_mcs_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_mcs_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_mcs_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_mcs_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_mcs_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_mcs_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_mcs_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_mcs_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_mcs_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"NN_DDC_EXN_INT_CPT_WRK_EXP_AMT","d":"The share of the fund's capital works write-off that it cannot deduct, usually because the building supports pension income.","full":"The share of the fund's capital works write-off that it cannot deduct, usually because the building supports pension income. The ATO says \"Write at label D2 the amount of capital works expenditure that isn't deductible. For example, if the SMSF uses the capital works area for the purposes of gaining or producing exempt income, such as exempt current pension income.\" Capital works covers construction, extensions, alterations and structural improvements, and the deductible share of the same calculation sits at label D1.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section C: Deductions and non-deductible expenses - item 12, label D2","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Non-deductible expenses - Capital works deductions","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section C label D2, SMSF annual return non-deductible expenses","def":"A whole-dollar amount in the non-deductible column, part of an annual write-off on building expenditure rather than a cash cost paid in the year.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section C: Deductions and non-deductible expenses - item 12, label D2","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","lim":"It measures the pension share of a building deduction, not spending on buildings, so it rises when a fund moves into pension phase even though the property has not changed. The separate non-deductible column was also added part way through the period this asset covers, so an early year can be empty rather than zero.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"NN_DDC_EXP_DPR_AST_VAL_DCL_AMT","d":"The part of the year's depreciation on the fund's assets that it cannot deduct.","full":"The part of the year's depreciation on the fund's assets that it cannot deduct. The ATO says \"Write at label E2 the amount for the decline in value of the SMSF's depreciating assets that isn't deductible. This includes an amount for the decline in value of a depreciating asset to the extent the asset is used for the purposes of gaining or producing exempt income, such as exempt current pension income.\" The deductible part of the same decline is at label E1, and the two together are the fund's full depreciation for the year.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section C: Deductions and non-deductible expenses - item 12, label E2","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Non-deductible expenses - Deduction for decline in value of depreciating assets","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section C label E2, SMSF annual return non-deductible expenses","def":"A whole-dollar non-cash amount, being the exempt-income share of the decline in value of fittings, plant and similar assets held by the fund.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section C: Deductions and non-deductible expenses - item 12, label E2","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","lim":"It is not a purchase or a payment, so it cannot be used to track fund investment in assets, and it says nothing about the assets' value, which is reported separately in Section H. Its size follows the fund's exempt income proportion, so two funds with identical assets can report very different amounts.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"NN_DDCTB_EXPN_INTS_WTH_AUS_AMT","d":"Interest on overseas borrowings that the fund cannot deduct, which is what the custodian's own description says this column holds.","full":"Interest on overseas borrowings that the fund cannot deduct, which is what the custodian's own description says this column holds. The ATO says \"Write at label B2 the amount of interest expenses that the SMSF incurred on borrowings from overseas sources that isn't deductible. This includes an amount of interest expense to the extent the expense is incurred for the purposes of gaining or producing exempt income.\" The deductible half of the same interest is at label B1 on the same row.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section C: Deductions and non-deductible expenses - item 12, label B2","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Non-deductible expenses - Interest expenses overseas","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section C label B2, SMSF annual return non-deductible expenses","def":"A whole-dollar amount in the non-deductible column of Section C, classified by where the lender is rather than by what the borrowing bought.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section C: Deductions and non-deductible expenses - item 12, label B2","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","lim":"The abbreviated variable name reads as within Australia while the custodian's description says overseas, the same reversal that runs through the other interest expense columns here, so the name must not be used to build the Australian against overseas split. The amount also reflects the fund's exempt income share rather than the cost of borrowing offshore.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"NN_DDCTB_EXPN_SMSF_AUD_FEE_AMT","d":"The part of the fund's audit fee it cannot deduct, which is the share attributable to exempt pension income.","full":"The part of the fund's audit fee it cannot deduct, which is the share attributable to exempt pension income. The ATO says \"Write at label H2 the amount for auditor fees that isn't deductible. This includes auditor fees to the extent the fees are incurred for the purposes of gaining or producing exempt income, such as exempt current pension income\", and requires a zero rather than a blank if there were none. Every SMSF must be audited each year, so the fee exists even when this column is zero.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section C: Deductions and non-deductible expenses - item 12, label H2","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Non-deductible expenses - Approved auditor fee","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section C label H2, SMSF annual return non-deductible expenses","def":"A whole-dollar amount in the non-deductible column, paired with the deductible audit fee at label H1; the two together are what the auditor charged.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section C: Deductions and non-deductible expenses - item 12, label H2","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","lim":"It is not the cost of the audit and cannot be used to price auditing, since a fund entirely in accumulation phase reports nothing here while still paying a fee. The custodian calls it the approved auditor fee while the current return calls it the SMSF auditor fee, and the separate non-deductible column was added part way through the period this asset covers, so an early year can carry no value.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"NN_DDCTBL_EXPNS_FRSTRY_MIS_AMT","d":"Payments to a forestry managed investment scheme that the fund cannot deduct.","full":"Payments to a forestry managed investment scheme that the fund cannot deduct. The ATO says \"Write at label U2 the total amount of payments made under an FMIS that aren't deductible\", and gives two reasons why a payment fails: it is one of the excluded payments set out in the appendix on forestry managed investment schemes, or the income from the scheme is exempt income of the fund. The deductible payments are at label U1, and the income side of the same scheme is at Section B label X.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section C: Deductions and non-deductible expenses - item 12, label U2","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Non-deductible expenses - Forestry managed investment scheme deduction","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section C label U2, SMSF annual return non-deductible expenses","def":"A whole-dollar amount in the non-deductible column, covering payments to a forestry scheme rather than a valuation of the forestry interest.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section C: Deductions and non-deductible expenses - item 12, label U2","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","lim":"It cannot be read as the fund's cost of forestry investing, because excluded payments and the pension share are mixed in the one figure and the deductible payments are recorded elsewhere. There is also a four-year holding rule for initial participants, so a disposal can turn earlier deductions around in ways this column does not show.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"NO_TFN_QTD_CNTRBTNS_TAX_AMT","d":"The penalty tax the fund pays on contributions made for a member whose tax file number it does not hold.","full":"The penalty tax the fund pays on contributions made for a member whose tax file number it does not hold. It is the top-up that lifts those contributions to the top rate: \"All SMSFs, complying and non-complying, have an overall tax rate of 47% on no-TFN-quoted contributions\", made up of 15 per cent at label T1 plus 32 per cent here for a complying fund, or 45 plus 2 per cent for a non-complying one. It is added to tax on taxable income to give gross tax.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section D: Income tax calculation statement - item 13, label J","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Tax on no-tfn quoted contributions","k":"Dollar amount reported at Section D label J, SMSF annual return calculation statement","def":"A whole-dollar amount worked out as a fixed percentage of the no-TFN-quoted contributions reported at Section B label R3, and mandatory, with a blank read as zero.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section D: Income tax calculation statement - item 13, label J","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","lim":"It measures a reporting failure rather than an economic quantity, and a fund can recover it later through a no-TFN tax offset, which appears at a different label and in a different year. The pension exemption does not reduce it, so it can be payable by a fund with no other tax.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"NON_ARMS_LNGTH_INCM_NET_AMT","d":"All of the fund's non-arm's length income for the year, added up and taxed at the top rate.","full":"All of the fund's non-arm's length income for the year, added up and taxed at the top rate. The ATO forms it by adding the private company dividend, trust distribution and other non-arm's length labels, and says that \"a tax rate of 45% is applied to the income you write at label U\" when tax on taxable income is worked out. Each component is already net of the deductions attributable to it, so the total is not comparable with the gross income labels that sit above it.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section B: Income - item 11, label U","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Net non-arm's length income","k":"Dollar total reported at Section B label U, SMSF annual return","def":"A whole-dollar total of labels U1, U2 and U3, excluded from the pension exemption that shelters the fund's other income.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return instructions 2025, Section B: Income - item 11, label U","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","lim":"A zero cannot be read as clean dealings, because whether a dealing was at arm's length is the trustee's own call and nothing on the face of the return tests it. The label also no longer captures every non-arm's length outcome: income arising from a non-arm's length general expense is dealt with inside the tax calculation instead, which the ATO notes means the label may not match the form's own 45 per cent descriptor.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"NON_ARMS_LNGTH_OI_NET_AMT","d":"Non-arm's length income the fund earned that was neither a private company dividend nor a trust distribution, net of the expenses attributed to it.","full":"Non-arm's length income the fund earned that was neither a private company dividend nor a trust distribution, net of the expenses attributed to it. The ATO directs the trustee to \"Write at label U3 any non-arm's length income which the complying SMSF has for 2024-25 and that wasn't included at labels U1 or U2\" (ATO, SMSF annual return 2025 instructions, Section B). It sits beside the private company dividend and trust distribution labels, and their total at label U is taxed at 45% rather than 15%.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section B: Income - item 11","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Net other non-arm's length income","k":"Dollar amount reported at SMSF annual return label U3","def":"Whole dollars with no cents, already reduced by the deductible expenses attributable to that income. It is one of the three components of net non-arm's length income at label U.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section B: Income - item 11","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-b-income-item-11","lim":"Only a complying fund separates this income out; a non-complying fund reports the same amounts among the ordinary income labels, so a zero does not mean the fund dealt at arm's length. Since the non-arm's length expense changes, income arising from a general expense under the twice-the-difference approach is deliberately kept out of this label and handled in the tax calculation, so the column understates what is taxed at the top rate.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"NON_ASSBL_FRGN_SF_AMT","d":"Money transferred in from a foreign superannuation fund that is not taxed in the Australian fund.","full":"Money transferred in from a foreign superannuation fund that is not taxed in the Australian fund. The ATO says to \"Write at label J the total amount transferred from a foreign super fund or scheme for the member in 2024-25 except any part of the transfer that is assessable income of the fund\" (ATO, SMSF annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G). The taxable part, being the growth not vested in the member at transfer, goes to label I, and any earnings the member elects to have taxed in the fund go to label M.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Non-assessable foreign superannuation fund amount","k":"Dollar amount reported at SMSF annual return label J, member sections","def":"Gross dollars of the non-assessable portion of a foreign transfer received for the member during the income year.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","lim":"Untaxed does not mean unconstrained: the amount counts against the member's non-concessional contributions cap in the year it arrives, which is where excess contributions problems on overseas transfers arise. The ATO says to \"Write at label L the non-assessable amount allocated from the SMSF's reserves to the member's account (other than amounts included at label O Allocated earnings or losses)\" (ATO, SMSF annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G), and adds that \"The amount written at label L is included in the member's non-concessional contributions\".","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Transfer from reserve: non-assessable amount","k":"Dollar amount reported at SMSF annual return label L, member sections","def":"Gross dollars allocated from a reserve during the income year that are not assessable to the fund, counted in the member's non-concessional contributions.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","lim":"Non-assessable to the fund does not mean free of consequence for the member, since the allocation still uses up non-concessional cap space. Most reserve allocations never reach this label: fair and reasonable allocations under 5% and allocations to pay a current pension liability are reported as allocated earnings instead, so the column understates movement out of reserves.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_mcs_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_mcs_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_mcs_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_mcs_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_mcs_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_mcs_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_mcs_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_mcs_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_mcs_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_mcs_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_mcs_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_mcs_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"NON_DDCTBL_EXPNS_INTST_OS_AMT","d":"Interest the fund incurred on borrowed money that it cannot deduct, usually the share relating to exempt pension income.","full":"Interest the fund incurred on borrowed money that it cannot deduct, usually the share relating to exempt pension income. The custodian's wording places it at label A2, where the ATO says to \"Write at label A2 the amount of interest expenses that the SMSF incurred on borrowings from Australian sources that isn't deductible\" (ATO, SMSF annual return 2025 instructions, Section C). The variable name says overseas while the custodian's description says within Australia, and the sibling column NN_DDCTB_EXPN_INTS_WTH_AUS_AMT carries the mirror image of the same conflict.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section C: Deductions and non-deductible expenses - item 12","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Non-deductible expenses - Interest expenses within Australia","k":"Dollar amount reported at SMSF annual return label A2","def":"Whole dollars, the non-deductible portion only; the deductible portion of the same borrowing sits at label A1 and the pair together is the fund's interest cost on that source of funds.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section C: Deductions and non-deductible expenses - item 12","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","lim":"The name and the label description point at opposite sides of the Australia against overseas split, so this column alone cannot tell you where the money was borrowed; the two interest columns have to be read together against the fund's totals. The deductible and non-deductible split is also the trustee's own apportionment rather than an ATO determination.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"NON_DDCTBL_EXPNS_INVMT_AMT","d":"Investment management costs the fund cannot deduct, in practice the share of them that relates to exempt current pension income.","full":"Investment management costs the fund cannot deduct, in practice the share of them that relates to exempt current pension income. The ATO says to \"Write at label I2 the amount of investment expenses that aren't deductible\" and that this \"includes an amount of investment expense to the extent the expense is incurred for the purposes of gaining or producing exempt income, such as ECPI\" (ATO, SMSF annual return 2025 instructions, Section C). The deductible share of the same costs is at label I1 on the same row.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section C: Deductions and non-deductible expenses - item 12","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Non-deductible expenses - Investment expenses","k":"Dollar amount reported at SMSF annual return label I2","def":"Whole dollars covering revenue-nature costs of managing or maintaining investments, such as adviser retainers, brokerage and portfolio servicing fees.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section C: Deductions and non-deductible expenses - item 12","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","lim":"The split between the deductible and non-deductible halves is the trustee's own apportionment, usually driven by an actuarial pension percentage, so the figure is a self-assessed allocation and not an audited fact. The ATO lists \"fees for setting up the SMSF\", \"legal fees incurred to amend a trust deed to include a new member\" and \"late lodgment penalties\" among them (ATO, SMSF annual return 2025 instructions, Section C). Auditor fees and investment management costs are kept out and reported at labels H2 and I2.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section C: Deductions and non-deductible expenses - item 12","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Non-deductible expenses - Management and administration expenses","k":"Dollar amount reported at SMSF annual return label J2","def":"Whole dollars of revenue-nature administration and management costs that the fund cannot claim, including the exempt-income share of otherwise deductible administration.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section C: Deductions and non-deductible expenses - item 12","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","lim":"It is not the cost of running the fund: the deductible half at label J1 usually holds most of the spending, since tax agent fees, the supervisory levy and interest charges are all deductible and never appear here. The ATO says to \"include income tax paid by the SMSF at label L2 as it isn't deductible at all\" (ATO, SMSF annual return 2025 instructions, Section C). A one-letter code in the box beside it names the biggest component, and the deductible counterpart is at label L1.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section C: Deductions and non-deductible expenses - item 12","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Non-deductible expenses - Other deductions","k":"Dollar amount reported at SMSF annual return label L2","def":"Whole dollars of residual non-deductible expenditure, paired on the same row with the category code at NON_DDCTBL_EXPNS_OTHR_CD.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section C: Deductions and non-deductible expenses - item 12","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","lim":"It cannot be decomposed. Income tax paid, forex losses, balancing adjustment losses and a return of contributions by a non-complying fund all land in one number, and only the largest of them is named by the code. It matches the rollover benefits statement the fund gave the receiving fund.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Outward rollover amounts","k":"Dollar amount reported at SMSF annual return label Q, member sections","def":"Gross dollars rolled over or transferred out during the income year, including family law splits and reversionary transfers on death.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","lim":"It is not money paid to the member: lump sums and pension payments are reported at the two payment labels, and a rollover only moves benefits between funds. The member must have given the fund the downsizer form before or when contributing, and the contribution sits outside the non-concessional cap.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Proceeds from primary residence disposal","k":"Dollar amount reported at SMSF annual return label H, member sections","def":"Gross dollars of downsizer contributions received for the member in the income year, bounded above by $300,000 for each person.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","lim":"It is not a measure of home sales by older Australians: only contributions supported by a valid downsizer form appear, and the money must reach the fund within the eligibility window. The ATO says to \"Write at label B the total value of personal contributions made for the member in 2024-25, other than contributions subject to elections to exclude them from the contributions caps\" (ATO, SMSF annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G). Contributions covered by a capital gains tax cap, personal injury or downsizer election are carved out to their own labels.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Personal contributions","k":"Dollar amount reported at SMSF annual return label B, member sections","def":"Gross dollars received for that member during the income year, before tax or fees, on a receipts basis.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","lim":"It does not say whether the money was concessional or non-concessional: a personal contribution the member later claims a deduction for is reported here either way, and only the notice of intent decides. Contributions received in one year but allocated in the next are still reported in the year of receipt, so this column is not the same as the amount credited to the member's account.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_mcs_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_mcs_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_mcs_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_mcs_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_mcs_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_mcs_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_mcs_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_mcs_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_mcs_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_mcs_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_mcs_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_mcs_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"PRSNL_INJRY_ELCTN_AMT","d":"Compensation for personal injury the member contributed to the fund and elected to keep outside their non-concessional cap.","full":"Compensation for personal injury the member contributed to the fund and elected to keep outside their non-concessional cap. The ATO defines the source of the money: \"Eligible personal injury payments are either of the following: a payment made under a written settlement agreement regarding a claim for damages for personal injury or a court order for such a claim, a workers compensation payment taken as a lump sum\" (ATO, SMSF annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G). The fund must hold a valid election before the contribution is made.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Personal injury election","k":"Dollar amount reported at SMSF annual return label E, member sections","def":"Gross dollars of contributions funded by an eligible personal injury payment, excluded from the member's non-concessional contributions.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","lim":"It measures a valid election, not an injury. If the election form arrived late, or the money was contributed more than 90 days after the settlement, the same payment is reported as an ordinary personal contribution, so the column undercounts injury settlements reaching superannuation. Nothing on the row says what the injury was or when it occurred.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_mcs_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_mcs_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_mcs_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_mcs_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_mcs_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_mcs_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_mcs_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_mcs_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_mcs_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_mcs_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_mcs_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_mcs_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"RBTS_OFSTS_FRGN_CRDTS_AMT","d":"Tax offsets that reduce the fund's gross tax but are lost if they exceed it, being the foreign income tax offset plus other rebates.","full":"Tax offsets that reduce the fund's gross tax but are lost if they exceed it, being the foreign income tax offset plus other rebates. The ATO warns that \"If the total of the 'non-refundable non-carry forward' tax offsets is greater than the gross tax, the excess can't be carried forward and is lost\" (ATO, SMSF annual return 2025 instructions, Section D). It is the sum of labels C1 and C2 and is the first thing subtracted from gross tax.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D: Income tax calculation statement - item 13","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Non-refundable non-carry forward tax offsets","k":"Dollar amount reported at SMSF annual return label C","def":"Whole dollars, the total of the foreign income tax offset at label C1 and the residual rebates and offsets at label C2.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D: Income tax calculation statement - item 13","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","lim":"The figure is a claim, not a benefit. Any part above gross tax vanishes without appearing anywhere else on the return, so this column overstates the tax relief a fund actually received. Its composition also depends on compliance status, because a non-complying fund's franking credits are routed into label C2 while a complying fund's go to the refundable side.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"RBTS_TAX_OFSTS_AMT","d":"Tax offsets the fund claims that fit no named label, and, for a non-complying fund, its franking credits.","full":"Tax offsets the fund claims that fit no named label, and, for a non-complying fund, its franking credits. The ATO says to \"Write at label C2 the total of rebates and tax offsets available other than those that are included at labels C1, D1 to D4 or E1 to E4\" (ATO, SMSF annual return 2025 instructions, Section D). A complying fund's franking credits are excluded and reported at label E1 instead, where they are refundable.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D: Income tax calculation statement - item 13","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Rebates and tax offsets","k":"Dollar amount reported at SMSF annual return label C2","def":"Whole dollars of residual tax offsets, forming part of the non-refundable non-carry forward total at label C.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D: Income tax calculation statement - item 13","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","lim":"The column means different things for different funds: identical franking credits are non-refundable here for a non-complying fund and refundable at label E1 for a complying one, so it cannot be compared across funds without the compliance status. It is also a residual, so nothing in it names the entitlement being claimed.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"RCPT_DT","d":"A date reported on the member's statement, most likely the day the fund received a downsizer contribution.","full":"A date reported on the member's statement, most likely the day the fund received a downsizer contribution. The member sections of the SMSF annual return carry one receipt date label, where the ATO says to \"Write at label H1 the date the downsizer contribution was received by the fund\" (ATO, SMSF annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G), and the same table carries the downsizer proceeds column beside this one. That mapping is an inference from the surrounding columns rather than a published record layout, so treat it as provisional.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information; ATO, Super member contributions statement for 2007-08 to 2011-12 financial years (NAT 71334)","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Receipt date (DDMMYYYY)","k":"Date (DDMMYYYY)","def":"A calendar date written as day, month and year, on a row that otherwise reports a whole financial year of contributions.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information; ATO, Super member contributions statement for 2007-08 to 2011-12 financial years (NAT 71334)","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","lim":"It cannot date contributions in general: every other contribution column is reported on a receipts basis for the whole financial year, so within-year timing is not recoverable from them. Downsizer contributions only start with contracts signed from 1 July 2018, so the column exists but stands empty in the earlier tables and a blank says nothing about when money arrived. Do not use this date to order events within a member's history until the ATO record layout is confirmed.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_mcs_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_mcs_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_mcs_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_mcs_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_mcs_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_mcs_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_mcs_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_mcs_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_mcs_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_mcs_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_mcs_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_mcs_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"RFNDBL_TAX_OFSTS_AMT","d":"Tax offsets the fund gets back in cash if they exceed its tax, dominated by franking credits on Australian dividends.","full":"Tax offsets the fund gets back in cash if they exceed its tax, dominated by franking credits on Australian dividends. The ATO explains that where the total \"is greater than the tax at label T3, show the excess at label I Tax offset refunds\" (ATO, SMSF annual return 2025 instructions, Section D). It totals the complying fund franking credits offset, the no-TFN offset, the national rental affordability scheme offset and the exploration credit offset.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D: Income tax calculation statement - item 13","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Refundable tax offsets","k":"Dollar amount reported at SMSF annual return label E","def":"Whole dollars, the sum of labels E1 to E4, applied last in the offset sequence.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D: Income tax calculation statement - item 13","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","lim":"It is the entitlement rather than the refund: the cash the fund receives for unused offsets is at label I, and the rest was absorbed by tax. Because franking credits dominate it, the column tracks Australian dividend exposure and the retirement phase more than it tracks any deliberate tax position.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"RMNDR_OF_RFNDBL_TAX_OFSTS_AMT","d":"The part of the fund's refundable offsets left after tax is reduced to zero, which comes back as cash.","full":"The part of the fund's refundable offsets left after tax is reduced to zero, which comes back as cash. The ATO says to \"Subtract the amount at label T3 Subtotal from label E Refundable tax offsets. Write the result at label I\" (ATO, SMSF annual return 2025 instructions, Section D). A fund wholly in pension phase with franked dividends typically shows the whole of its franking credits here.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D: Income tax calculation statement - item 13","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Tax offset refunds (Remainder of refundable tax offsets)","k":"Dollar amount reported at SMSF annual return label I","def":"Whole dollars, the excess of refundable offsets over remaining tax, entered as a credit in the final calculation.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D: Income tax calculation statement - item 13","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","lim":"It is not the refund the fund receives. The final position at label S also nets off eligible credits, PAYG instalments already raised and the supervisory levy, so a fund with a large amount here can still owe money. A zero means the offsets were fully absorbed by tax, not that the fund had none.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"RNTL_CPTL_WRKS_DDCTNS_AMT","d":"The deduction the fund claims for building and structural works, written off over many years rather than in the year of the spending.","full":"The deduction the fund claims for building and structural works, written off over many years rather than in the year of the spending. The ATO defines the category: \"Capital works include the construction, extension, alteration and improvement of any capital asset (such as buildings, dams and roads) and structural improvements such as fences, retaining walls and sealed driveways\" (ATO, SMSF annual return 2025 instructions, Section C). The non-deductible share for a pension-paying fund sits separately at label D2.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section C: Deductions and non-deductible expenses - item 12","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Capital works deductions","k":"Dollar amount reported at SMSF annual return label D1","def":"Whole dollars of the annual capital works write-off, typically 2.5% of qualifying construction expenditure, not the amount spent during the year.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section C: Deductions and non-deductible expenses - item 12","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-c-deductions-and-non-deductible-expenses-item-12","lim":"It is not construction spending: the ATO's own example turns $40,000 of renovation into a $1,000 deduction, so the column understates building activity by a factor of forty in the first year and repeats for decades afterwards. The variable name suggests a rental-specific measure, but the label covers any capital works of the fund, including on commercial property.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"RSDNTL_RL_PRPTY_AMT","d":"Market value at 30 June of housing the fund owns directly in Australia.","full":"Market value at 30 June of housing the fund owns directly in Australia.
