Residential property acquired with borrowed money is excluded and reported at label J1 instead.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section H: Assets and liabilities - items 15 and 16","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Residential real property","k":"Dollar amount reported at SMSF annual return label L, assets and liabilities","def":"Whole dollars at market value on the last day of the income year, from the fund's balance sheet.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section H: Assets and liabilities - items 15 and 16","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","lim":"It says nothing about use or occupancy: the rent, if any, is in Section B, and this column cannot distinguish a tenanted investment from a vacant one. The ATO says to \"Write at label X the total value of assets not allocated to members on 30 June 2025\" and warns that \"The use of reserve accounts is strictly limited for SMSFs\" (ATO, SMSF annual return 2025 instructions, Section H). It is reported among liabilities, beside total member closing account balances.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section H: Assets and liabilities - items 15 and 16","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Reserve accounts","k":"Dollar amount reported at SMSF annual return label X","def":"Whole dollars of unallocated assets at the end of the income year, forming part of total liabilities, which must equal total assets.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section H: Assets and liabilities - items 15 and 16","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-h-assets-and-liabilities-items-15-and-16","lim":"The NUM suffix reads as a number of reserve accounts and it is not; treating it as a count will produce values in the hundreds of thousands. It also says nothing about the kind of reserve or why it exists, and because the ATO restricts SMSF reserves a large value is closer to a compliance signal than to an ordinary balance.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"SBTOTL_2_AMT","d":"The fund's tax after the non-refundable offsets have been applied, and before franking credits and the other refundable ones.","full":"The fund's tax after the non-refundable offsets have been applied, and before franking credits and the other refundable ones. The ATO says that \"If the amount at label T2 is greater than the total of the non-refundable carry forward tax offsets at label D, the remaining tax is shown at label T3 Subtotal 2\" (ATO, SMSF annual return 2025 instructions, Section D). What happens next depends on whether refundable offsets exceed it: the shortfall becomes tax payable, the excess becomes a refund.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D: Income tax calculation statement - item 13","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"SUBTOTAL 2","k":"Dollar amount reported at SMSF annual return label T3","def":"Whole dollars, floored at zero, sitting between subtotal 1 at label T2 and tax payable at label T5 in the calculation statement.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D: Income tax calculation statement - item 13","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","lim":"It is an intermediate step, not a liability, and it is easily mistaken for the fund's tax bill. Zero has two meanings here, a fund with no taxable income and a fund whose offsets wiped out its tax, and this column cannot tell them apart without the gross tax and offset columns beside it.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"SBTOTL_AMT","d":"The fund's income tax after every offset is applied, which the return calls tax payable rather than a subtotal.","full":"The fund's income tax after every offset is applied, which the return calls tax payable rather than a subtotal. The ATO instruction is to \"Subtract the amount at label E Refundable tax offsets from label T3 Subtotal\" and \"Write the result at label T5\" (ATO, SMSF annual return 2025 instructions, Section D). The variable name is misleading: the sibling column NEW_SBTOTL_AMT holds subtotal 1, while this one holds the tax.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D: Income tax calculation statement - item 13","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"TAX PAYABLE","k":"Dollar amount reported at SMSF annual return label T5","def":"Whole dollars, mandatory, with a blank treated as zero by the ATO's own processing rule.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D: Income tax calculation statement - item 13","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","lim":"It is not what the fund pays with the return. The supervisory levy, the section 102AAM interest charge, eligible credits and PAYG instalments already raised are all applied afterwards to give the amount due or refundable. Because zero is both common and mandatory, a zero cannot be distinguished from a question that did not apply.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"SF_SID","d":"The self-managed fund itself, carried as a scrambled code so a fund's return can be joined to its members' statements.","full":"The self-managed fund itself, carried as a scrambled code so a fund's return can be joined to its members' statements. It is the key that ties the fund-level annual return table to the member-level table, in the same way that the member contributions data uses provider and supplier scrambled identifiers for the entities that lodge. The Productivity Commission describes the general method, whereby the ABS replaces a source identifier with a synthetic one so that tables can be connected without re-identifying the entity.","dsrc":"Productivity Commission, 'A-PLIDA-nalysis: Using PLIDA for public policy research and reporting', section on the Person Linkage Spine","durl":"https://assets.pc.gov.au/research/completed/plida/plida.pdf","dp":"ai","vp":"ai","od":"Fund scrambled identifier","k":"Scrambled identifier for a self-managed superannuation fund","def":"An opaque code with no meaning in its digits, one value per fund, repeated on every row belonging to that fund within the SMSF tables.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"Productivity Commission, 'A-PLIDA-nalysis: Using PLIDA for public policy research and reporting', section on the Person Linkage Spine","url":"https://assets.pc.gov.au/research/completed/plida/plida.pdf","lim":"It identifies a fund, not a person: a couple's fund is a single value covering two members, so counting distinct values counts funds and not people. The ATO says to \"Write at label H5 the total tax withheld from payments where the SMSF as a beneficiary of the trust hasn't provided its TFN to the trustee of a closely held trust and the payment is subject to the TFN withholding rules\" (ATO, SMSF annual return 2025 instructions, Section D). Those market linked pensions are reported at label S2 instead.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Retirement phase account balance - CDBIS","k":"Dollar amount reported at SMSF annual return label S3, member sections","def":"Whole dollars at 30 June, the third part of the member's closing account balance, covering pensions defined as capped defined benefit income streams in the income tax law.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","lim":"The exclusion of market linked pensions means this column is narrower than the capped defined benefit concept used for the transfer balance cap, so it will not reproduce that population. Where it is supplied, the ATO uses it instead of the label S2 balance in working out the total superannuation balance.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Retirement phase value","k":"Dollar amount reported at SMSF annual return label X2, member sections","def":"Whole dollars at 30 June, covering non-capped defined benefit retirement accounts only, and reported conditionally where it differs from the label S2 balance.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","lim":"Blank is the normal case and means the value equals the account balance, so a reader who reads blanks as zero will understate retirement phase wealth. The ATO says \"Label L shows the amount of supervisory levy due for 2025-26 ($259). Don't change the amount printed on the annual return\" (ATO, SMSF annual return 2025 instructions, Section D), and adds that \"The levy is payable even if the SMSF has no tax liability\".","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D: Income tax calculation statement - item 13","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Supervisory levy","k":"Dollar amount reported at SMSF annual return label L, income tax calculation statement","def":"A single fixed dollar amount for the income year, the same for every fund lodging that year, and $259 on the 2025 return.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D: Income tax calculation statement - item 13","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","lim":"It carries no information about the fund. SMSFs that are lodging their first annual return haven't paid this amount previously\" (ATO, SMSF annual return 2025 instructions, Section D). It is added to the amount due, so a first return carries a double levy.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D: Income tax calculation statement - item 13","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Supervisory levy adjustment for new funds","k":"Dollar amount reported at SMSF annual return label N","def":"Either blank or the full year levy for the income year being reported, $259 on the 2025 return, and never any other value.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D: Income tax calculation statement - item 13","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","lim":"It flags a fund's first return, but not reliably: the ATO also requires the matching first return answer in Section A, and a trustee who leaves this label blank produces a first return that looks like any other. Unlike the wind-up adjustment, it increases what the fund owes rather than reducing it, so the two adjustment columns must not be treated as a pair of offsets.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"SPRVSRY_LVY_WND_UP_FND_ADJ_AMT","d":"A credit that cancels the levy for a fund that wound up during the year, so it does not pay for a year in which it will not exist.","full":"A credit that cancels the levy for a fund that wound up during the year, so it does not pay for a year in which it will not exist. The ATO says \"An SMSF which was wound up during 2024-25 doesn't pay the SMSF supervisory levy for 2025-26. Writing $259 at label M reduces the levy payable by $259\" (ATO, SMSF annual return 2025 instructions, Section D). It is subtracted in working out the amount due or refundable.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D: Income tax calculation statement - item 13","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Supervisory levy adjustment for wound up funds","k":"Dollar amount reported at SMSF annual return label M","def":"Either blank or the full year levy, $259 on the 2025 return, and never a part year amount.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D: Income tax calculation statement - item 13","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","lim":"It is not a complete register of wind-ups. The ATO's own table leaves this label blank for a fund that was both newly registered and wound up in the same year, so counting wind-ups on this column misses first-year funds that closed. It also gives no wind-up date; that comes from the wind-up date and indicator columns in Section A.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"SPS_CHLD_CNTRBTNS_AMT","d":"Money put into the member's account by their spouse, or by a parent or relative for a member under 18.","full":"Money put into the member's account by their spouse, or by a parent or relative for a member under 18. The ATO defines the label as covering \"contributions made by the member's spouse\" and \"contributions made by parents, relatives or others on behalf of a member who is under 18 years old\" (ATO, SMSF annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G). Contributions from a former or separated spouse are excluded and reported as other third party contributions.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Spouse and child contributions","k":"Dollar amount reported at SMSF annual return label F, member sections","def":"Gross dollars received for the member during the income year from a spouse or, for a child member, from a family contributor.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Sections F and G: Member and supplementary member information","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/sections-f-and-g-member-and-supplementary-member-information","lim":"The two kinds are not separated, so a spouse contribution and a grandparent's gift to a teenage member are the same number and cannot be told apart. Contributions splitting transfers are excluded to the inward rollover label, so this is not a measure of money moving between partners.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_mcs_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_mcs_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_mcs_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_mcs_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_mcs_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_mcs_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_mcs_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_mcs_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_mcs_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_mcs_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_mcs_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_mcs_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"SYNTHETIC_AEUID","d":"The individual member a superannuation statement belongs to, carried as a meaningless code in place of a name or tax file number.","full":"The individual member a superannuation statement belongs to, carried as a meaningless code in place of a name or tax file number. The Productivity Commission describes how it is built: \"The ABS transforms unique identifiers in the original dataset into a Synthetic AEUID, enabling the datasets within PLIDA modules to be connected with one another, while preventing re-identification in the dataset outside of it\". It is the only person-level key on the row, so grouping by it turns member statements into one person's superannuation history, while SF_SID beside it identifies the fund.","dsrc":"Productivity Commission, 'A-PLIDA-nalysis: Using PLIDA for public policy research and reporting', section on the Person Linkage Spine","durl":"https://assets.pc.gov.au/research/completed/plida/plida.pdf","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Synthetic id of individual person on dataset","k":"PLIDA synthetic person identifier (Agency Entity Unique ID)","def":"An opaque code standing in for the person's identifier in the source data, repeated across the datasets from the same source, with no age, sex, location or account information in the value and nothing to decode or order.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"Productivity Commission, 'A-PLIDA-nalysis: Using PLIDA for public policy research and reporting', section on the Person Linkage Spine","url":"https://assets.pc.gov.au/research/completed/plida/plida.pdf","lim":"It is not a common key across agencies: the Productivity Commission notes that \"Synthetic AEUIDs are unique to an entity within a data source and are not repeated across sources\", so a value matching one in Census or Centrelink data is a coincidence and any cross-module join has to go through the spine concordance tables. One person can also appear on several rows in a year through membership of more than one fund, so counting rows counts memberships rather than people.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_mcs_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_mcs_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_mcs_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_mcs_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_mcs_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_mcs_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_mcs_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_mcs_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_mcs_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_mcs_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_mcs_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_mcs_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"TAX_LDGMT_PMT_OBLGTNS_IND","d":"The trustees' own yes or no answer on whether the fund has met all its tax lodgement and payment obligations.","full":"The trustees' own yes or no answer on whether the fund has met all its tax lodgement and payment obligations. The question hangs off item 9, which asks whether the fund was wound up during the income year, and the instruction is to \"Print X in the appropriate box, either No or Yes at item 9\". For a fund being wound up the ATO is asking whether the trustees have paid all outstanding debts, paid out or transferred all member benefits, and lodged all previous years' annual returns.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section A: SMSF information (items 1 to 10)","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-a-smsf-information-items-1-to-10","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Have all tax lodgment and payment obligations been met?","k":"Yes or no answer at Section A item 9 of the SMSF annual return","def":"A two-state indicator, yes or no, with a blank where the trustees left the box empty. It carries no amount, no date and no detail of which obligation was outstanding.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section A: SMSF information (items 1 to 10)","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-a-smsf-information-items-1-to-10","lim":"It cannot establish that the obligations were met. The box records what the trustees asserted on the day they lodged, and a later ATO review can contradict it. Because the question sits inside the wind-up item, a blank is far more often a fund that kept operating than a fund in default, so counting blanks as non-compliance is wrong.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"TAX_LSS_CF_AMT","d":"The stock of tax losses the fund still has available to deduct in later years.","full":"The stock of tax losses the fund still has available to deduct in later years. The ATO says to \"Write at label U the total tax losses of the SMSF that are to be carried forward to later income years\", made up of this year's tax loss plus prior year losses \"to the extent that they haven't previously been utilised\". Net capital losses are excluded and go at label V, and losses tied to non-arm's length income are excluded altogether.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section E: Losses (item 14)","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-e-losses-item-14","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Tax losses carried forward to later income years","k":"Dollar amount at Section E label U, tax losses carried forward","def":"A whole-dollar balance with no cents, and a stock rather than a flow: the current year loss added to the unused remainder of earlier losses. Net exempt income for the year is netted off before the current year loss is worked out.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section E: Losses (item 14)","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-e-losses-item-14","lim":"It is not this year's loss. A fund with a profitable year can still carry a large balance from years past, and a fund with a bad year can show nil because net exempt income absorbed the loss. It also understates unrecouped losses, since losses attached to non-arm's length income are kept only in the fund's own records.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"TAX_ON_TI_AMT","d":"Tax worked out on the fund's taxable income alone, before any other charge, offset or credit.","full":"Tax worked out on the fund's taxable income alone, before any other charge, offset or credit. The rate depends on the fund's status and on how the income arose: \"All assessable income for a non-complying SMSF is taxed at 45%\", while a complying fund pays 15% on its arm's length income and 45% on the non-arm's length component. The next label adds tax on no-TFN-quoted contributions, and the two together make gross tax at label B.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D: Income tax calculation statement (item 13)","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Tax on taxable income","k":"Dollar amount at Section D label T1, tax on taxable income","def":"A whole-dollar tax amount computed from label A. For a complying fund it is 15% of taxable income less the non-arm's length component, plus 45% of that component; for a non-complying fund it is 45% of the whole.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D: Income tax calculation statement (item 13)","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","lim":"It is not the fund's tax bill and not a tax rate numerator you can trust on its own. Franking and other credits, tax offsets, the supervisory levy and PAYG instalments all sit between this figure and the amount finally due, and dividing it by taxable income only recovers 15% for funds with no non-arm's length income.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"TI_AMT","d":"The taxable income the fund's tax is actually calculated on, which is set to zero whenever the fund made a loss.","full":"The taxable income the fund's tax is actually calculated on, which is set to zero whenever the fund made a loss. The ATO instruction is explicit about the censoring: transfer the Section C figure to label A if it is income, but \"Yes - Write 0 (zero) at label A\" if it is a loss. This is the Section D copy of the figure, not the signed Section C figure that the loss version of this column carries.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D: Income tax calculation statement (item 13)","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"Taxable income","k":"Dollar amount at Section D label A, taxable income used for the tax calculation","def":"A whole-dollar amount, never negative, that equals the Section C taxable income or loss when that figure is positive and zero otherwise. It is one of the five mandatory labels, so a blank is treated as zero.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D: Income tax calculation statement (item 13)","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","lim":"A zero does not mean the fund broke even. It means the fund made a loss whose size shows up only at Section C or in the carried-forward losses at Section E, so an average built on this column censors every loss-making fund at zero and overstates the typical fund's position.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"TI_LSS_AMT","d":"The fund's assessable income less its deductions, signed, so a loss-making fund shows a negative figure.","full":"The fund's assessable income less its deductions, signed, so a loss-making fund shows a negative figure. It is the Section C label O total that the calculation statement starts from: \"You wrote the SMSF's taxable income, or its loss, at Section C, item 12 - label O Taxable income or loss.\" Exempt current pension income has already been taken out before this line.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D: Income tax calculation statement (item 13)","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"TAXABLE INCOME OR LOSS","k":"Dollar amount at Section C label O, taxable income or loss (signed)","def":"A whole-dollar amount that may be positive or negative, being total assessable income, including assessable contributions and net non-arm's length income, less allowable deductions.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D: Income tax calculation statement (item 13)","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","lim":"It is a tax figure, not a measure of what the fund earned. A fund paying pensions can hold large investments and report a small taxable income because exempt current pension income was removed first. Read against the Section D taxable income on the same row, the difference is the size of the loss, not an error.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"TOTL_DUE_RFNDBL_AMT","d":"The bottom line of the fund's tax calculation, with the sign carrying the direction of the payment.","full":"The bottom line of the fund's tax calculation, with the sign carrying the direction of the payment. The ATO says the label \"can be zero, positive or negative\", that \"a positive amount is what you must pay to us\" and that \"a negative amount is the refund you will receive\". It is built by adding tax payable, the section 102AAM interest charge, the supervisory levy and the new-fund levy adjustment, then subtracting eligible credits, tax offset refunds, PAYG instalments raised and the wound-up levy adjustment.","dsrc":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D: Income tax calculation statement (item 13)","durl":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","dp":"official","vp":"ai","od":"AMOUNT DUE OR REFUNDABLE","k":"Signed dollar amount at Section D, amount due or refundable","def":"A signed whole-dollar amount covering income tax and the SMSF supervisory levy together, net of credits and instalments already raised for the year.","p":"2007-2008 to 2022-2023","s":"sourced","src":"ATO, Self-managed superannuation fund annual return 2025 instructions, Section D: Income tax calculation statement (item 13)","url":"https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/self-managed-superannuation-fund-annual-return-2025-instructions/instructions-to-complete-your-smsf-annual-return-2025/section-d-income-tax-calculation-statement-item-13","lim":"It is not tax on income, and it is not cash moved. The supervisory levy is inside it, so a fund with no taxable income still shows an amount due; and interim or voluntary payments the fund has already made are deliberately left out of the calculation, so the figure differs from what the trustees actually remitted. A negative value is a refund, so summing the column without keeping the sign turns refunds into liabilities.","where":["pmp-smsf-2007-08 / smsf_itr_2007_08","pmp-smsf-2008-09 / smsf_itr_2008_09","pmp-smsf-2009-10 / smsf_itr_2009_10","pmp-smsf-2010-11 / smsf_itr_2010_11","pmp-smsf-2011-12 / smsf_itr_2011_12","pmp-smsf-2012-13 / smsf_itr_2012_13","pmp-smsf-2013-14 / smsf_itr_2013_14","pmp-smsf-2014-15 / smsf_itr_2014_15","pmp-smsf-2015-16 / smsf_itr_2015_16","pmp-smsf-2016-17 / smsf_itr_2016_17","pmp-smsf-2017-18 / smsf_itr_2017_18","pmp-smsf-2018-19 / smsf_itr_2018_19","and 4 more"]},{"n":"TOTL_TOFA_GNS_AMT","d":"Gains the fund brought to account on financial arrangements under the taxation of financial arrangements rules.","full":"Gains the fund brought to account on financial arrangements under the taxation of financial arrangements rules. The ATO instruction is to \"Write at label H the SMSF's total assessable TOFA gains from financial arrangements\", and only a small group of funds ever reaches the label: the rules apply where \"the value of the SMSF's assets is $100 million or more\" or where the fund elected in.
